name: Alakazam
flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

name: Chansey
flavorText: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

name: Charizard
flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

name: Machamp
flavorText: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

name: Magneton
flavorText: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Nidoking
flavorText: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Poliwrath
flavorText: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Venusaur
flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

name: Pidgeotto
flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

name: Dratini
flavorText: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

name: Farfetch'd
flavorText: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

name: Haunter
flavorText: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

name: Ivysaur
flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Jynx
flavorText: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

name: Kadabra
flavorText: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

name: Machoke
flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

name: Nidorino
flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Poliwhirl
flavorText: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

name: Porygon
flavorText: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

name: Raticate
flavorText: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

name: Seel
flavorText: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: Often hides in water to stalk unweary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

name: Abra
flavorText: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Charmander
flavorText: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Diglett
flavorText: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

name: Doduo
flavorText: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

name: Machop
flavorText: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

name: Metapod
flavorText: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavorText: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

name: Onix
flavorText: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

name: Pidgey
flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

name: Starmie
flavorText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

name: Staryu
flavorText: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Monster Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

name: Clefable
flavorText: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

name: Flareon
flavorText: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: It accumulates negative ions from the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: If interrupted while miming, it will slap around the enemy with its broad hands.

name: Nidoqueen
flavorText: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

name: Pidgeot
flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Pinsir
flavorText: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

name: Scyther
flavorText: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of it.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin that is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Venomoth
flavorText: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

name: Victreebel
flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Dodrio
flavorText: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Fearow
flavorText: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

name: Gloom
flavorText: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool; it is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a stinging sensation when it licks enemies.

name: Marowak
flavorText: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to K.O. targets.

name: Nidorina
flavorText: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

name: Parasect
flavorText: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

name: Persian
flavorText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Primeape
flavorText: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until its quarry is caught.

name: Rapidash
flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Rhydon
flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

name: Seaking
flavorText: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

name: Tauros
flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Weepinbell
flavorText: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

name: Bellsprout
flavorText: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

name: Cubone
flavorText: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from elemental stones.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Goldeen
flavorText: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname "Water Queen."

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Mankey
flavorText: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next.

name: Meowth
flavorText: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Oddish
flavorText: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

name: Paras
flavorText: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

name: Spearow
flavorText: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

name: Venonat
flavorText: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Aerodactyl
flavorText: A ferocious prehistoric Pokémon that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Ditto
flavorText: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

name: Dragonite
flavorText: An extremely rarely seen marine Pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

name: Gengar
flavorText: Under a full moon, this Pokémon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

name: Haunter
flavorText: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

name: Hypno
flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

name: Kabutops
flavorText: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

name: Lapras
flavorText: A Pokémon that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across water.

name: Magneton
flavorText: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

name: Moltres
flavorText: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

name: Muk
flavorText: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary thunderbird Pokémon whose anger is said to cause storms. Some say it has lived above the clouds for thousands of years.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary thunderbird Pokémon whose anger is said to cause storms. Some say it has lived above the clouds for thousands of years.

name: Arbok
flavorText: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

name: Cloyster
flavorText: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

name: Gastly
flavorText: A mysterious Pokémon. Some say it is a lifeform from another dimension, while other believe it is formed from smog.

name: Golbat
flavorText: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

name: Golduck
flavorText: Often seen swimming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

name: Golem
flavorText: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

name: Graveler
flavorText: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

name: Kingler
flavorText: The large pincer has 10,000 horsepower of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Found at the mouths of volcanoes and extremely hard to spot. There are very few instances of capturing this Pokémon.

name: Omastar
flavorText: A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible for it to catch prey.

name: Sandslash
flavorText: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

name: Seadra
flavorText: Capable of swimming backward by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: The Shellder that is latched onto Slowpoke's tail is said to feed on the host's left-over scraps.

name: Tentacruel
flavorText: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

name: Weezing
flavorText: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two Koffings can fuse into a Weezing over many years.

name: Ekans
flavorText: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds such as Pidgey and Spearow whole.

name: Geodude
flavorText: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Grimer
flavorText: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: Horsea
flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Kabuto
flavorText: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

name: Krabby
flavorText: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

name: Omanyte
flavorText: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.

name: Shellder
flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Tentacool
flavorText: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

name: Zubat
flavorText: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

name: Nidorino
flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Parasect
flavorText: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

name: Persian
flavorText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Poliwhirl
flavorText: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

name: Raticate
flavorText: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

name: Rhydon
flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

name: Seaking
flavorText: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

name: Seel
flavorText: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Tauros
flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: Often hides in water to stalk unweary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

name: Weepinbell
flavorText: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

name: Abra
flavorText: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

name: Bellsprout
flavorText: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Charmander
flavorText: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Cubone
flavorText: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

name: Diglett
flavorText: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

name: Doduo
flavorText: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

name: Goldeen
flavorText: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname "Water Queen."

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Machop
flavorText: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

name: Meowth
flavorText: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Metapod
flavorText: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavorText: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

name: Onix
flavorText: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

name: Paras
flavorText: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

name: Pidgey
flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: Spearow
flavorText: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

name: Starmie
flavorText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

name: Staryu
flavorText: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

name: Venonat
flavorText: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

name: Dark Alakazam
flavorText: Almost as if it were being controlled by something else, it never changes expressions, even in the middle of battle.

name: Dark Arbok
flavorText: Freezes its prey with its stare. If you should encounter one, remember not to look into its eyes.

name: Dark Blastoise
flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

name: Dark Charizard
flavorText: Seemingly possessed, it spews fire like a volcano, trying to burn all it sees.

name: Dark Dragonite
flavorText: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

name: Dark Dugtrio
flavorText: Digs large sinkholes in the ground and tries to trap its enemies in them.

name: Dark Golbat
flavorText: Sneaks up silently on its prey and attacks it from behind, sometimes killing it with one bite.

name: Dark Gyarados
flavorText: Normally found only in the deep ocean, it has recently been seen in shallow waters as well.

name: Dark Hypno
flavorText: Carries a pendulum with it always. Sometimes appears near less-traveled roads and schools at dusk.

name: Dark Machamp
flavorText: It is almost impossible to defend against a Machamp's four powerful arms.

name: Dark Magneton
flavorText: The number of incidents of hackers using Magnetons to damage computer systems is steadily increasing.

name: Dark Slowbro
flavorText: It loves nothing better than to be left alone, and so sometimes ends up being manipulated by unscrupulous people.

name: Dark Vileplume
flavorText: Perhaps because of their strong-smelling pollen, other Pokémon do not approach areas where Vileplumes live.

name: Dark Weezing
flavorText: Researchers have observed these Pokémon reproducing in industrial waste sites.

name: Dark Kadabra
flavorText: Some people say that Kadabras are responsible for many of the mysterious events reported in the news.

name: Dark Machoke

name: Dark Muk
flavorText: Muks appear suddenly, spreading sludge everywhere. Whenever one appears in a city, panic ensues.

name: Dark Persian
flavorText: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

name: Dark Primeape
flavorText: Although Primeapes have always been mean, lately they seem to be becoming even more vicious and frenzied.

name: Dark Rapidash
flavorText: A wild, uncontrollable Pokémon. When running, it looks like a comet streaking through the sky.

name: Dark Vaporeon
flavorText: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

name: Dark Wartortle
flavorText: A Pokémon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood—which is often.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: Recent research has revealed the presence of dragon DNA in this species of Pokémon.

name: Porygon
flavorText: More and more people play the slots every day, trying to win a Porygon.

name: Abra
flavorText: It teleports itself away from danger, making it difficult to capture.

name: Charmander
flavorText: Many people find it cute and try to hold it, only to be burned by its tail.

name: Dark Raticate
flavorText: A Raticate's front teeth are incredibly powerful; it can destroy a two-story house with them in 5 minutes.

name: Diglett
flavorText: It follows Onixes in their tunnels, looking for scraps of food they have left behind.

name: Dratini
flavorText: The capture of the first Dratini inspired the search for other legendary Pokémon.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: Not popular with girls because of its attitude. Can often be heard muttering to itself in a low voice.

name: Eevee
flavorText: A rare and unique Pokémon about which little is known, as few have been captured.

name: Ekans
flavorText: A carnivore that swallows its prey whole. Pidgeys and Spearows are its favorite food.

name: Grimer
flavorText: It has recently been found that Grimers are formed in waste-processing plants, and can move into towns via sewers.

name: Koffing
flavorText: First discovered in a weapons factory, this Pokémon can now be found almost anywhere.

name: Machop
flavorText: It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a Machop.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It is said that enough Magnemites and Magnetons gather in one place, they can create a powerful magnetic barrier.

name: Mankey
flavorText: Normally friendly, it quickly becomes angry if it doesn't get what it wants.

name: Meowth
flavorText: A popular Pokémon that earns money for its owner with its "Pay Day" ability.

name: Oddish
flavorText: It wanders around at night sowing its seeds to create more Oddishes.

name: Ponyta

name: Psyduck
flavorText: It is often seen holding its head in its paws, as if it were suffering from a headache.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Loves to eat walnuts, chestnuts, cheese, and milk.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: Although it knows how to fish, no other intelligent behavior has been detected in it.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: Cute Pokémon that charms people with its innocent eyes. Loves swimming all day long.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: Usually seen only in power plants, it is sometimes seen in towns, apparently using the power lines to travel.

name: Zubat
flavorText: Lives in dark caves. Can occasionally be seen at night, when it flies in search of food.

name: Dark Raichu
flavorText: Stores up electricity in its body, then suddenly releases it to surprise and shock everyone.

name: Alakazam
flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Charizard
flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

name: Gyarados

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: It accumulates negative ions from the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

name: Machamp
flavorText: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

name: Muk
flavorText: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Venusaur
flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Golem
flavorText: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

name: Hypno
flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

name: Jynx
flavorText: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

name: Kabutops
flavorText: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

name: Magneton
flavorText: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Moltres
flavorText: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

name: Nidoking
flavorText: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

name: Nidoqueen

name: Pidgeot

name: Pidgeotto

name: Rhydon

name: Haunter

name: Kadabra

name: Machoke

flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

name: Scizor
flavorText: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

name: Entei
flavorText: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

name: Pichu
flavorText: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

name: Igglybuff
flavorText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Unown [J]
flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Machamp
flavorText: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

name: Scyther
flavorText: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

name: Mew
flavorText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

name: Snivy
flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Snivy
flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Servine
flavorText: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

name: Servine
flavorText: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

name: Serperior
flavorText: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

name: Serperior
flavorText: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

name: Pansage
flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

name: Simisage
flavorText: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

name: Petilil
flavorText: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

name: Lilligant
flavorText: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

name: Maractus
flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

name: Maractus
flavorText: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

name: Deerling
flavorText: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

name: Sawsbuck
flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Pignite
flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Pansear
flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

name: Simisear
flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue, then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

name: Dewott
flavorText: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

name: Dewott
flavorText: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

name: Samurott
flavorText: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

name: Samurott
flavorText: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

name: Panpour
flavorText: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

name: Simipour
flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

name: Basculin
flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food—peat moss.

name: Swanna
flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Alomomola
flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Alomomola
flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Joltik
flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Joltik
flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Munna
flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

name: Musharna
flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Woobat
flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat
flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

name: Venipede
flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

name: Whirlipede
flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

name: Scolipede
flavorText: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponent and poison them.

name: Solosis
flavorText: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

name: Duosion
flavorText: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thought, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.

name: Reuniclus
flavorText: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

name: Timburr
flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of timber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

name: Timburr
flavorText: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

name: Gurdurr
flavorText: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

name: Throh
flavorText: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

name: Sawk
flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

name: Sandile
flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

name: Zorua
flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

name: Klink
flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Klang
flavorText: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

name: Klinklang
flavorText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watches for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

name: Watchog
flavorText: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

name: Herdier
flavorText: It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

name: Pidove
flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

name: Tranquill
flavorText: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

name: Unfezant
flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

name: Audino
flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Minccino
flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

name: Bouffalant
flavorText: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

name: Bouffalant
flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: This is an extremely rare Pikachu card. You're very lucky to have found it!

name: Surskit
flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

name: Masquerain
flavorText: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

name: Lileep
flavorText: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

name: Cradily
flavorText: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

name: Tropius
flavorText: It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.

name: Karrablast
flavorText: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

name: Shelmet
flavorText: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

name: Accelgor
flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So it wraps a membrane around itself for protection while it spits poison.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

name: Lapras
flavorText: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
flavorText: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

name: Suicune
flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

name: Glalie
flavorText: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

name: Froslass
flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

name: Snover
flavorText: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

name: Tirtouga
flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.

name: Carracosta
flavorText: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Eelektross
flavorText: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: These Pokémon are called the "Signpost for Wandering Spirits." Children holding them sometimes vanish.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can't be a fixed destination.

name: Uxie
flavorText: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.

name: Mesprit
flavorText: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.

name: Azelf
flavorText: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.

name: Munna
flavorText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Musharna
flavorText: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

name: Solosis
flavorText: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

name: Duosion
flavorText: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

name: Reuniclus
flavorText: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.

name: Golett
flavorText: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It's been active for thousands of years.

name: Golurk
flavorText: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.

name: Machop
flavorText: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.

name: Machoke
flavorText: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

name: Machamp
flavorText: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

name: Machamp
flavorText: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

name: Throh
flavorText: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

name: Sawk
flavorText: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

name: Archen
flavorText: It was revived from an ancient fossil. Not able to fly, it lived in treetops and hopped from one branch to another.

name: Archeops
flavorText: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

name: Houndour
flavorText: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

name: Aron
flavorText: In order to build up its steel body, it eats iron ore. This pesky Pokémon is known to eat railroad tracks.

name: Lairon
flavorText: Lairon fight over territory, and when their steel bodies collide, sparks fly.

name: Aggron
flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

name: Escavalier
flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Bagon
flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Shelgon
flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

name: Salamence
flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

name: Axew
flavorText: Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.

name: Fraxure
flavorText: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

name: Haxorus
flavorText: Its tusks are incredibly destructive. They can easily slice through a thick, sturdy steel column every time.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby play only when it feels safe.

name: Porygon
flavorText: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.

name: Porygon2
flavorText: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

name: Ursaring
flavorText: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

name: Chatot
flavorText: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

name: G Booster
subtype: Pokémon Tool, ACE SPEC, Team Plasma

name: G Scope
subtype: Pokémon Tool, ACE SPEC, Team Plasma

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Virizion
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: Using its tentacles to lash itself to trees, it lies in wait for prey, luring it close with sweet-smelling drool.

name: Snivy
flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Servine
flavorText: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

name: Serperior
flavorText: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

name: Dwebble
flavorText: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

name: Crustle
flavorText: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

name: Virizion
flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

name: Charizard
flavorText: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Each of its nine tails is imbued with supernatural power, and it can live for a thousand years.

name: Moltres
flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When it trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Piplup
flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

name: Phione
flavorText: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

name: Dewott
flavorText: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

name: Samurott
flavorText: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

name: Tympole
flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

name: Seismitoad
flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

name: Kyurem
flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Minun
flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Emolga
flavorText: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

name: Thundurus
flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

name: Natu
flavorText: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

name: Xatu
flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

name: Ralts
flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

name: Woobat
flavorText: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

name: Swoobat
flavorText: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothita
flavorText: It stares intently at everything. It can become so obsessed with watching that it doesn't notice attacks.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Solosis
flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others

name: Solosis
flavorText: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

name: Duosion
flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

name: Reuniclus
flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: Lucario
flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

name: Gallade
flavorText: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Landorus
flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Meloetta
flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Zorua
flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

name: Altaria
flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Gible
flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

name: Gabite
flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

name: Deino
flavorText: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

name: Swablu
flavorText: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

name: Minccino
flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Bouffalant
flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

name: Tornadus
flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Snivy
flavorText: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

name: Servine
flavorText: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

name: Serperior
flavorText: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior's noble eyes.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

name: Piplup
flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Ralts
flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: When its opponent can't be paralyzed, it contorts itself with unexpected speed and flops away.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

name: Ursaring
flavorText: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

name: Audino
flavorText: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

name: Minccino
flavorText: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

name: Emolga
flavorText: It glides on its outstretched membrane while shocking foes with the electricity stored in the pouches on its cheeks.

name: Pansage
flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

name: Simisage
flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

name: Whimsicott
flavorText: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

name: Whimsicott
flavorText: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

name: Petilil
flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

name: Lilligant
flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

name: Deerling
flavorText: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
flavorText: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

name: Virizion
flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

name: Pansear
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600º F.

name: Simisear
flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500º F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

name: Panpour
flavorText: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

name: Simipour
flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Basculin
flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

name: Basculin
flavorText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna
flavorText: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

name: Beartic
flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

name: Beartic
flavorText: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

name: Emolga
flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

name: Joltik
flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Thundurus
flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Woobat
flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat
flavorText: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

name: Venipede
flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

name: Whirlipede
flavorText: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

name: Scolipede
flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothita
flavorText: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

name: Roggenrola
flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

name: Roggenrola
flavorText: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

name: Boldore
flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

name: Boldore
