flavorText: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

name: Gigalith
flavorText: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Excadrill
flavorText: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

name: Throh
flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

name: Sawk
flavorText: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

name: Sandile
flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

name: Liepard
flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

name: Zorua
flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

name: Ferrothorn
flavorText: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Ferrothorn
flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

name: Klink
flavorText: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

name: Klang
flavorText: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

name: Klinklang
flavorText: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

name: Watchog
flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Pidove
flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

name: Tranquill
flavorText: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

name: Unfezant
flavorText: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves fell close to anyone other than their Trainers.

name: Audino
flavorText: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

name: Minccino
flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

name: Braviary
flavorText: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

name: Tornadus
flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Thundurus
flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Tornadus
flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

name: Petilil
flavorText: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

name: Lilligant
flavorText: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

name: Dwebble
flavorText: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

name: Crustle
flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

name: Karrablast
flavorText: When they feel threatened, they spit acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

name: Foongus
flavorText: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

name: Amoonguss
flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

name: Shelmet
flavorText: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

name: Accelgor
flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

name: Virizion
flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Pansear
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.

name: Simisear
flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Tympole
flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: It lives in water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

name: Seismitoad
flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

name: Tirtouga
flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

name: Carracosta
flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

name: Vanillish
flavorText: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

name: Vanilluxe
flavorText: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

name: Frillish
flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

name: Jellicent
flavorText: The fate of ships and crew that wander into Jellicent's habitats: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

name: Cryogonal
flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Cryogonal
flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Kyurem
flavorText: It generates powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Emolga
flavorText: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross
flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Victini
flavorText: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

name: Yamask
flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Yamask
flavorText: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

name: Cofagrigus
flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Cofagrigus
flavorText: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

name: Solosis
flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Duosion
flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

name: Reuniclus
flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

name: Reuniclus
flavorText: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

name: Elgyem
flavorText: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

name: Elgyem
flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Beheeyem
flavorText: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel it burns.

name: Litwick
flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Gigalith
flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

name: Timburr
flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr
flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr
flavorText: It it thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

name: Conkeldurr
flavorText: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

name: Archen
flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

name: Archeops
flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a volt of electricity.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attack. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Mienshao
flavorText: It wield the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arms attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Golett
flavorText: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

name: Golurk
flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Landorus
flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Pawniard
flavorText: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Deino
flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Escavalier
flavorText: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

name: Durant
flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves against Heatmor.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

name: Audino
flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Axew
flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Fraxure
flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

name: Haxorus
flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Virizion
flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

name: Meowth
flavorText: This is an extremely rare Meowth card. Maybe good fortune will come to you if you hold this card!

name: Pinsir
flavorText: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

name: Seedot
flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Kricketot
flavorText: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

name: Kricketune
flavorText: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Pansage
flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

name: Simisage
flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Foongus
flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

name: Amoonguss
flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature, it will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature, it will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

name: Moltres
flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

name: Pansear
flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

name: Simisear
flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

name: Litwick
flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavorText: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Staryu
flavorText: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

name: Starmie
flavorText: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

name: Lapras
flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

name: Lapras
flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Panpour
flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Basculin
flavorText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: Vanillish
flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

name: Vanilluxe
flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

name: Frillish
flavorText: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

name: Jellicent
flavorText: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

name: Beartic
flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Shinx
flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Shinx
flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Emolga
flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Grimer
flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

name: Muk
flavorText: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

name: Ralts
flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Munna
flavorText: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

name: Musharna
flavorText: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

name: Elgyem
flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Beheeyem
flavorText: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: Lucario
flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: They has mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.

name: Mienshao
flavorText: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

name: Weavile
flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: It immediately headbutts anyones that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

name: Persian
flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

name: Pidove
flavorText: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: Minccino
flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

name: Emboar
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

name: Ivysaur
flavorText: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

name: Venusaur
flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

name: Scyther
flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It binds itself to trees on marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

name: Dwebble
flavorText: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

name: Crustle
flavorText: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

name: Karrablast
flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Shelmet
flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

name: Accelgor
flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

name: Flareon
flavorText: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

name: Combusken
flavorText: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

name: Blaziken
flavorText: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch it foes.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.

name: Piplup
flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

name: Glaceon
flavorText: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

name: Tympole
flavorText: They warn other of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas surrounding them.

name: Vanillish
flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food—peat moss.

name: Swanna
flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Minun
flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Joltik
flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Joltik
flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Espeon
flavorText: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

name: Slowking
flavorText: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

name: Woobat
flavorText: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

name: Yamask
flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Cofagrigus
flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Aerodactyl
flavorText: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
flavorText: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

name: Excadrill
flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Timburr
flavorText: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

name: Gurdurr
flavorText: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

name: Umbreon
flavorText: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Umbreon
flavorText: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Sandile
flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

name: Zorua
flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zorua
flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

name: Escavalier
flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

name: Klink
flavorText: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

name: Klang
flavorText: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

name: Klinklang
flavorText: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Chansey
flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Chansey
flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Blissey
flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

name: Chatot
flavorText: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

name: Herdier
flavorText: It has a black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

name: Haxorus
flavorText: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Archeops
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Hoppip
flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Skiploom
flavorText: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

name: Jumpluff
flavorText: Blown by the seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

name: Yanma
flavorText: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

name: Wurmple
flavorText: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

name: Silcoon
flavorText: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

name: Beautifly
flavorText: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

name: Cascoon
flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Nincada
flavorText: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

name: Ninjask
flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

name: Roselia
flavorText: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

name: Roselia
flavorText: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

name: Roserade
flavorText: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

name: Roserade
flavorText: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

name: Maractus
flavorText: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

name: Foongus
flavorText: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

name: Magmar
flavorText: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

name: Wailord
flavorText: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

name: Feebas
flavorText: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Milotic
flavorText: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

name: Spheal
flavorText: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

name: Sealeo
flavorText: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

name: Walrein
flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through the water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

name: Tympole
flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, the can make wave in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Seismitoad
flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

name: Alomomola
flavorText: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

name: Electrike
flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Electrike
flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Emolga
flavorText: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

name: Dustox
flavorText: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.

name: Shedinja
flavorText: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

name: Drifloon
flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

name: Drifblim
flavorText: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: Gothita
flavorText: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Golett
flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: Golurk
flavorText: It flies around the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: Cubone
flavorText: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

name: Marowak
flavorText: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

name: Nosepass
flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It move by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

name: Claydol
flavorText: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

name: Roggenrola
flavorText: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

name: Boldore
flavorText: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

name: Gigalith
flavorText: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally are fired from its mouth.

name: Throh
flavorText: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

name: Sawk
flavorText: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

name: Houndour
flavorText: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

name: Stunky
flavorText: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

name: Skuntank
flavorText: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

name: Aron
flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Lairon
flavorText: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes it steely body against others to fight over territory.

name: Aggron
flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

name: Probopass
flavorText: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Durant
flavorText: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.

name: Altaria
flavorText: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

name: Gible
flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

name: Gible
flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

name: Gabite
flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

name: Gabite
flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

name: Deino
flavorText: It tends to bit everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

name: Deino
flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Aipom
flavorText: It lives high among the treetops. It can us its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

name: Vigoroth
flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

name: Slaking
flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

name: Swablu
flavorText: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes of dirt with its wings.

name: Swablu
flavorText: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes of dirt with its wings.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.

name: Bibarel
flavorText: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by the people nearby.

name: Audino
flavorText: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has radarlike ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.

name: Minccino
flavorText: They great one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

name: Bouffalant
flavorText: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a trail.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

name: Braviary
flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Serperior
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Reuniclus
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Oddish
flavorText: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

name: Gloom
flavorText: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

name: Bellossom
flavorText: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

name: Scyther
flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Heracross
flavorText: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Servine
flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

name: Serperior
flavorText: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

name: Whimsicott
flavorText: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

name: Petilil
flavorText: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

name: Lilligant
flavorText: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

name: Charizard
flavorText: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

name: Numel
flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Camerupt
flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years–or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Victini
flavorText: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Pignite
flavorText: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 F.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.

name: Golduck
flavorText: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

name: Golduck
flavorText: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.

name: Marill
flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Azumarill
flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott
flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

name: Samurott
flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavorText: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Frillish
flavorText: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

name: Jellicent
flavorText: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

name: Cryogonal
flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on contact.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

name: Electivire
flavorText: The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Wobbuffet
flavorText: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

name: Spoink
flavorText: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.

name: Grumpig
flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

name: Duskull
flavorText: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.

name: Dusclops
flavorText: It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

name: Munna
flavorText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Musharna
flavorText: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

name: Woobat
flavorText: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

name: Swoobat
flavorText: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

name: Venipede
flavorText: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state.

name: Whirlipede
flavorText: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But, when predators approach, it moves to stab them with poison spikes.

name: Scolipede
flavorText: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

name: Sandslash
flavorText: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It clamps on to its chosen prey then jabs the stinger on its tail into the prey while it's stunned with surprise.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Dwebble
flavorText: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

name: Crustle
flavorText: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

name: Mienshao
flavorText: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: It makes a nest out of the bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

name: Scizor
flavorText: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speed of over 180 mph.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

name: Klink
flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Flygon
flavorText: Known as "The Desert Spirit" this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Black Kyurem
flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: White Kyurem
flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Rattata
flavorText: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.

name: Raticate
flavorText: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

name: Farfetch'd
flavorText: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

name: Ditto
flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

name: Togepi
flavorText: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

name: Taillow
flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavorText: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.

name: Spinda
flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

name: Buneary
flavorText: By extending its rolled up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Watchog
flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

name: Herdier
flavorText: This very loyal Pokémon helps trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

name: Pidove
flavorText: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

name: Tranquill
flavorText: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

name: Unfezant
flavorText: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.

name: Audino
flavorText: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

name: Golurk
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Altaria
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.

name: Grotle
flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

name: Torterra
flavorText: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's back and spend their entire life there.

name: Combee
flavorText: This Pokémon is a set of three. When they sleep, they gather up and form a giant hive of 100 Combee.

name: Vespiquen
flavorText: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

name: Cherrim
flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Maractus
flavorText: When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.

name: Foongus
flavorText: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.

name: Amoonguss
flavorText: It moves the caps on both arms and does a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp places.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

name: Monferno
flavorText: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

name: Infernape
flavorText: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hand and feet. It will take on any opponent.

name: Pansear
flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

name: Simisear
flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.

name: Lampent
flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Swinub
flavorText: Rooting the tip of its snout into the ground, it searches for food. Sometimes, it even digs up a hot spring.

name: Piloswine
flavorText: With its excellent sense of smell, it's even able to find mushrooms that are buried under frozen ground.

name: Mamoswine
flavorText: When the temperature rose at the end of the ice age, most Mamoswine disappeared.

name: Lotad
flavorText: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

name: Lombre
flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Ludicolo
flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as

name: Manaphy
flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

name: Vanillish
flavorText: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

name: Vanilluxe
flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

name: Frillish
flavorText: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

name: Jellicent
flavorText: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

name: Beartic
flavorText: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways around the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavorText: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.

name: Magneton
flavorText: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

name: Joltik
flavorText: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense.

name: Zubat
flavorText: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surrounding while it flies.

name: Zubat
flavorText: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surrounding while it flies.

name: Golbat
flavorText: Flitting around in the dead of night, it sinks its fangs into its prey and drains a nearly fatal amount of blood.

name: Crobat
flavorText: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

name: Weezing
flavorText: Inhaling toxic fumes from trash and mixing them inside its body lets it spread an even fouler stench.

name: Ralts
flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gallade
flavorText: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

name: Giratina
flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

name: Elgyem
flavorText: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

name: Elgyem
flavorText: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

name: Beheeyem
flavorText: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Donphan
flavorText: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Solrock
flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: Riolu
flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras made tangible by their emotions.

name: Lucario
flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

name: Lucario
flavorText: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Timburr
flavorText: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

name: Gurdurr
flavorText: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

name: Conkeldurr
flavorText: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

name: Klink
flavorText: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. They spin around each other to generate energy.

name: Klang
flavorText: A minigear and big gear comprises its body. If the minigear it launches at its foe doesn't return, it will die.

name: Klinklang
