flavorText: The minigear spins at high speed. Then the energy from the red core charges the minigear to make it ready to fire.

name: Durant
flavorText: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

name: Durant
flavorText: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes them float.

name: Clefable
flavorText: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.

name: Doduo
flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with telepathic power.

name: Dodrio
flavorText: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

name: Togepi
flavorText: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

name: Togetic
flavorText: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind-hearted people.

name: Togekiss
flavorText: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.

name: Whismur
flavorText: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

name: Loudred
flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Exploud
flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Extremely cautious, there is always one keeping watch, but they don't notice enemies coming from behind.

name: Watchog
flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Watchog
flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Bouffalant
flavorText: They are known to charge so wildly that if a train were to enter their territory, they would send it flying.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: It stands up to massive opponents, not out of courage, but out of recklessness. But that is how it gets stronger.

name: Braviary
flavorText: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

name: Charizard
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Weedle
flavorText: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

name: Treecko
flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Grovyle
flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Sceptile
flavorText: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

name: Cacnea
flavorText: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

name: Cacturne
flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: With cells similar to those of plants, it performs photosynthesis inside its body and creates pure air.

name: Flareon
flavorText: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees F.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.

name: Lampent
flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

name: Horsea
flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

name: Seadra
flavorText: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional-medicine ingredients.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can't be seen when it melts away into water.

name: Wooper
flavorText: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

name: Quagsire
flavorText: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Glaceon
flavorText: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

name: Tympole
flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

name: Seismitoad
flavorText: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

name: Vanillish
flavorText: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

name: Vanilluxe
flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

name: Cryogonal
flavorText: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148° F.

name: Kyurem
flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: By storing electricity in its body, it can shoot its bristlelike fur like a barrage of missiles.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavorText: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from its barbs can be fatal.

name: Nidorina
flavorText: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than Nidorino's.

name: Nidoqueen
flavorText: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

name: Nidorino
flavorText: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

name: Grimer
flavorText: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

name: Muk
flavorText: It's so stinky! Muk's body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

name: Espeon
flavorText: Its fur is so sensitive, it can feel minute shifts in the air and predict the weather…and its foes' thoughts.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Beldum
flavorText: Its cells are all magnetic, and it communicates with others by using magnetic pulses.

name: Metang
flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

name: Metagross
flavorText: With four linked brains, it's more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.

name: Yamask
flavorText: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.

name: Yamask
flavorText: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.

name: Cofagrigus
flavorText: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

name: Cofagrigus
flavorText: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

name: Nidoking
flavorText: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

name: Mankey
flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

name: Primeape
flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

name: Onix
flavorText: Opening its large mouth, it ingests massive amounts of soil and creates long tunnels.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

name: Umbreon
flavorText: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it's filled with a mysterious power.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: A smart and sneaky Pokémon, it makes its opponents flinch by suddenly showing the claws hidden in its paws.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.

name: Absol
flavorText: It appears from deep in the mountains to warn people about upcoming disasters it has sensed with its horn.

name: Sandile
flavorText: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

name: Deino
flavorText: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

name: Deino
flavorText: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

name: Steelix
flavorText: The iron it ingested with the soil it swallowed transformed its body and made it harder than diamonds.

name: Mawile
flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Dratini
flavorText: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

name: Dragonite
flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

name: Kingdra
flavorText: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

name: Rattata
flavorText: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.

name: Raticate
flavorText: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Hoothoot
flavorText: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world's ways.

name: Noctowl
flavorText: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Miltank
flavorText: It is said that kids who drink Miltank's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

name: Kecleon
flavorText: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

name: Starly
flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Staravia
flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

name: Staraptor
flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Snivy
flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Axew
flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Pansage
flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are know to relieve stress.

name: Zorua
flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Minccino
flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

name: Pansage
flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

name: Pidove
flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

name: Axew
flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Serperior
flavorText: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Samurott
flavorText: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

name: Axew
flavorText: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

name: Thundurus
flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Tornadus
flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Landorus
flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Kyurem
flavorText: It generates powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Altaria
flavorText: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

name: Lilligant
flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

name: Crobat
flavorText: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

name: Flygon
flavorText: Known as "The Desert Spirit," this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Elgyem
flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

name: Haxorus
flavorText: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

name: Black Kyurem
flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: White Kyurem
flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

name: Virizion
flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

name: Giratina
flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Metagross
flavorText: With four linked brains, it's more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Landorus
flavorText: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

name: Lucario
flavorText: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

name: Flareon
flavorText: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.

name: Glaceon
flavorText: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.

name: Espeon
flavorText: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

name: Umbreon
flavorText: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Mew
flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Ho-Oh
flavorText: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Kyogre
flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Palkia
flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

name: Mew
flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Xerneas
flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Cosmog
flavorText: Whether or not it's a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.

name: Cosmoem
flavorText: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

name: Lunala
flavorText: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.

name: Groudon
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Solgaleo
flavorText: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name "the beast that devours the sun."

name: Lugia
flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Mew
flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

name: Charizard
flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

name: Venusaur
flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Dark Gyarados
flavorText: Normally found only in the deep ocean, it has recently been seen in shallow waters as well.

name: Cleffa
flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Shining Magikarp
flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Clefable
flavorText: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Dialga
flavorText: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

name: Espeon
flavorText: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

name: Forretress
flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Groudon
flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Ho-Oh
flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven-colored wings.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Jirachi
flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

name: Kyogre
flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Lugia
flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

name: Palkia
flavorText: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

name: Umbreon
flavorText: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Cleffa
flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Feraligatr
flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: Granbull
flavorText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

name: Meganium
flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: Its fingertips emit a peculiar force field that hardens air to create an actual wall.

name: Pidgeot
flavorText: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: Slowking
flavorText: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. It can even eat things off the ground.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

name: Typhlosion
flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: Tyrogue
flavorText: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Ursaring
flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

name: Weezing
flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

name: Zangoose
flavorText: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

name: Bayleef
flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: Croconaw
flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Donphan
flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

name: Flareon
flavorText: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Magby
flavorText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

name: Mime Jr.
flavorText: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

name: Pidgeotto
flavorText: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

name: Quilava
flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

name: Riolu
flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Seviper
flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sunrays.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

name: Cyndaquil
flavorText: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: Eevee
flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

name: Houndour
flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

name: Magmar
flavorText: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Mawile
flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

name: Pidgey
flavorText: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Tangela
flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

name: Totodile
flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Dialga
flavorText: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

name: Entei
flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Groudon
flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Ho-Oh
flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven-colored wings.

name: Kyogre
flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

name: Lugia
flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Palkia
flavorText: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

name: Raikou
flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

name: Suicune
flavorText: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

name: Team Magma's Numel
flavorText: No matter how heavy the cargo, we can transport it to our destination with ease, thanks to Numel.

name: Team Magma's Camerupt
flavorText: Camerupt, with its strength against fire, played a big role in rescuing team members.

name: Team Aqua's Spheal
flavorText: Spheal's Water Gun can put out any fire. Flames used by opponents have no effect!

name: Team Aqua's Sealeo
flavorText: It provides support by making paths of ice. It can win any battle as long as it's on ice.

name: Team Aqua's Walrein
flavorText: It's good at attacks that freeze opponents with a powerful cold snap. Then, it pulverizes a frozen foe with its sharp tusks!

name: Team Aqua's Grimer
flavorText: Its flexible body, which allows it to squeeze into any cracks, comes in handy when invading enemy hideouts.

name: Team Aqua's Muk
flavorText: It immobilizes its opponents by wrapping them in its huge, poisonous body. It'll smoosh you, too!

name: Team Aqua's Seviper
flavorText: Seviper's tail is a sharp blade. It can even poison you!

name: Team Magma's Baltoy
flavorText: They all cry out at once to let us know when they spot an enemy. It really helps out!

name: Team Magma's Claydol
flavorText: Claydol's beam can seize opponents and keep them from moving. Long-range attacks are its specialty!

name: Team Magma's Aron
flavorText: Aron, which even devour metal, can eat and destroy enemy ships in an instant.

name: Team Magma's Lairon
flavorText: When Lairon uses Take Down, the impact from its solid body is enough to destroy concrete!

name: Team Magma's Aggron
flavorText: Aggron's metal horns can smash through any defenses, no matter how strong!

name: Team Aqua's Poochyena
flavorText: Poochyena can easily detect invading foes with its acute sense of smell. It's an excellent lookout!

name: Team Magma's Poochyena
flavorText: Poochyena's nose can identify any scent. It's very useful for reconnaissance.

name: Team Aqua's Mightyena
flavorText: Thanks to Mightyena's outstanding leadership, it's very good at combination attacks that can leave a foe helpless.

name: Team Magma's Mightyena
flavorText: This Pokémon is loyal to its master. It will protect its partner to the end, no matter what.

name: Team Aqua's Carvanha
flavorText: You can't keep up with its movements underwater, can you? If you get caught in this whirlpool, there'll be no escape.

name: Team Aqua's Sharpedo
flavorText: It boasts fangs so powerful that they knock opponents out in one shot! Enemies that slip up will be taken down without fail!

name: Team Magma's Zangoose
flavorText: Can you handle the formation attack of the fearless Zangoose?

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

name: Ludicolo
flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

name: Morelull
flavorText: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charizard
flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

name: Greninja
flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Detective Pikachu
flavorText: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: This Pokémon was created by years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Machamp
flavorText: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it "the Machamp special."

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

name: Ditto
flavorText: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.

name: Slaking
flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

name: Electivire
flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

name: Infernape
flavorText: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

name: Luxray
flavorText: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

name: Palkia
flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Rhyperior
flavorText: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

name: Roserade
flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

name: Skuntank
flavorText: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

name: Staraptor
flavorText: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

name: Torterra
flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

name: Azumarill
flavorText: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

name: Beautifly
flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

name: Bibarel
flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Clefable
flavorText: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

name: Drapion
flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

name: Dustox
flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

name: Gengar
flavorText: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools that area by nearly 10 degrees F.

name: Heracross
flavorText: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

name: Machamp
flavorText: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

name: Medicham
flavorText: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

name: Munchlax
flavorText: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

name: Noctowl
flavorText: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Purugly
flavorText: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

name: Steelix
flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Vespiquen
flavorText: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

name: Wobbuffet
flavorText: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

name: Wynaut
flavorText: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

name: Budew
flavorText: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

name: Cascoon
flavorText: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

name: Cherrim
flavorText: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

name: Dusclops
flavorText: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

name: Elekid
flavorText: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can't store the energy it makes.

name: Grotle
flavorText: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

name: Machoke
flavorText: MACHOKE's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

name: Magneton
flavorText: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

name: Mantyke
flavorText: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

name: Monferno
flavorText: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

name: Rapidash
flavorText: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

name: Rhydon
flavorText: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.

name: Riolu
flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Seaking
flavorText: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

name: Silcoon
flavorText: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.

name: Staravia
flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

name: Unown [A]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [B]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [C]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [D]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Azurill
flavorText: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Bonsly
flavorText: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

name: Buneary
flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

name: Chatot
flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.

name: Cleffa
flavorText: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.

name: Combee
flavorText: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

name: Duskull
flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

name: Gastly
flavorText: This Pokémon's body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.

name: Glameow
flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness if very popular among some.

name: Goldeen
flavorText: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.

name: Hoothoot
flavorText: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.

name: Machop
flavorText: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

name: Marill
flavorText: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.

name: Meditite
flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Mime Jr.
flavorText: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

name: Onix
flavorText: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

name: Piplup
flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.

name: Roselia
flavorText: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

name: Seedot
flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Skorupi
flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

name: Starly
flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Stunky
flavorText: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

name: Wurmple
flavorText: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

name: Aggron
flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

name: Alakazam
flavorText: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

name: Azelf
flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

name: Blissey
flavorText: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

name: Celebi
flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but is is said to appear only in peaceful times.

name: Feraligatr
flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

name: Lumineon
flavorText: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

name: Meganium
flavorText: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

name: Mesprit
flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

name: Raichu
flavorText: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

name: Typhlosion
flavorText: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

name: Tyranitar
flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

name: Uxie
flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

name: Ariados
flavorText: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

name: Bastiodon
flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

name: Chimecho
flavorText: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.

name: Crobat
flavorText: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.

name: Glalie
flavorText: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.

name: Kricketune
flavorText: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Mantine
flavorText: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of Mantine swimming as if they are in flight.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

name: Nidoqueen
flavorText: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

name: Rampardos
flavorText: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

name: Slaking
flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Unown [I]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Ursaring
flavorText: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

name: Walrein
flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

name: Whiscash
flavorText: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting of tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.

name: Bayleef
flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

name: Chingling
flavorText: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

name: Cranidos
flavorText: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

name: Croconaw
flavorText: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

name: Dodrio
flavorText: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

name: Gabite
flavorText: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scale will heal even incurable illnesses.

name: Girafarig
flavorText: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.

name: Golbat
flavorText: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

name: Graveler
flavorText: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.

name: Happiny
flavorText: It loves round white things. It carries and egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

name: Lairon
flavorText: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

name: Masquerain
flavorText: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

name: Nidorina
flavorText: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

name: Octillery
flavorText: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.

name: Parasect
flavorText: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

name: Quilava
flavorText: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burn more strongly when it readies to fight.

name: Sandslash
flavorText: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

name: Sealeo
flavorText: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

name: Shieldon
flavorText: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

name: Tropius
flavorText: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.

name: Unown [E]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [M]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [T]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Vigoroth
flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

name: Abra
flavorText: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

name: Aipom
flavorText: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

name: Aron
flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Barboach
flavorText: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Chansey
flavorText: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

name: Cyndaquil
flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

name: Doduo
flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Electrike
flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

name: Finneon
flavorText: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

name: Geodude
flavorText: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

name: Gible
flavorText: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

name: Kricketot
flavorText: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

name: Magby
flavorText: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees F. It is healthy if it is breathing yellow flames.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavorText: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

name: Paras
flavorText: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.

name: Pichu
flavorText: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

name: Seel
flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.

name: Snover
flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

name: Spheal
flavorText: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

name: Surskit
flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every sets of paws tastes unique.

name: Totodile
flavorText: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer need to be careful.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

name: Zubat
flavorText: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

name: Charizard
flavorText: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

name: Entei
flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Flygon
flavorText: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as "The Desert Spirit."

name: Gallade
flavorText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

name: Gastrodon East Sea
flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

name: Gastrodon West Sea
flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

name: Ho-Oh
flavorText: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

name: Jumpluff
flavorText: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

name: Ludicolo
flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

name: Lugia
flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

name: Mew
flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Raikou
flavorText: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

name: Roserade
flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

name: Salamence
flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

name: Suicune
flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Venusaur
flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

name: Absol
flavorText: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

name: Banette
flavorText: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

name: Electivire
flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Furret
flavorText: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

name: Golduck
flavorText: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.

name: Golem
flavorText: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.

name: Jynx
flavorText: It cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

name: Minun
flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Mothim
flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

name: Nidoking
flavorText: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

name: Pidgeot
flavorText: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as "The Bully of the Sea."

name: Sunflora
flavorText: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

name: Unown [S]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Wormadam Trash Cloak
flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Xatu
flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

name: Breloom
flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

name: Cloyster
flavorText: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

name: Donphan
flavorText: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

name: Farfetch'd
flavorText: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Ivysaur
flavorText: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

name: Kecleon
flavorText: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer's feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

name: Lombre
flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Miltank
flavorText: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

name: Muk
flavorText: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

name: Nidorino
flavorText: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

name: Pidgeotto
flavorText: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

name: Pinsir
flavorText: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

name: Quagsire
flavorText: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

name: Raticate
flavorText: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

name: Roselia
flavorText: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Shelgon
flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

name: Skiploom
flavorText: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

name: Smoochum
flavorText: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

name: Unown [K]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [N]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [O]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [X]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [Z]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Venomoth
flavorText: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Bagon
flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

name: Burmy Plant Cloak
flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Burmy Trash Cloak
flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Carvanha
