flavorText: They can swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

name: Corsola
flavorText: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can't live in polluted waters.

name: Diglett
flavorText: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

name: Grimer
flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

name: Hoppip
flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.

name: Lotad
flavorText: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Natu
flavorText: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Pidgey
flavorText: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: If its usual headache worsens, its starts exhibiting odd powers. It can't remember doing so, however.

name: Qwilfish
flavorText: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

name: Ralts
flavorText: It uses the thorns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

name: Sentret
flavorText: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

name: Shellder
flavorText: It swims backwards by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

name: Shellos East Sea
flavorText: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

name: Shellos West Sea
flavorText: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

name: Spinda
flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Stantler
flavorText: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

name: Sunkern
flavorText: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Venonat
flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At nights, its kind is drawn by light.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

name: Wooper
flavorText: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.

name: Blaziken
flavorText: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Sceptile
flavorText: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

name: Swampert
flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

name: Togekiss
flavorText: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

name: Altaria
flavorText: It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight. It hums with its soprano voice.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

name: Claydol
flavorText: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Exploud
flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

name: Hypno
flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even if someone just woke up.

name: Kingler
flavorText: The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.

name: Lapras
flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

name: Latias
flavorText: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

name: Latios
flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

name: Mawile
flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Milotic
flavorText: When people bicker, it is said to arise from the depths of lakes to becalm violent hearts.

name: Palkia
flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Primeape
flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

name: Slowking
flavorText: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

name: Unown [H]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Wailord
flavorText: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

name: Weezing
flavorText: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

name: Arbok
flavorText: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.

name: Cacturne
flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

name: Combusken
flavorText: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

name: Gorebyss
flavorText: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

name: Granbull
flavorText: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

name: Grovyle
flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

name: Huntail
flavorText: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

name: Linoone
flavorText: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

name: Loudred
flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Magcargo
flavorText: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.

name: Marshtomp
flavorText: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

name: Metapod
flavorText: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

name: Pelipper
flavorText: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.

name: Porygon2
flavorText: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.

name: Purugly
flavorText: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

name: Seviper
flavorText: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.

name: Togetic
flavorText: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called "joy dust."

name: Unown [F]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [G]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

name: Zangoose
flavorText: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

name: Cacnea
flavorText: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive 30 days without water.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

name: Clamperl
flavorText: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

name: Ekans
flavorText: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

name: Feebas
flavorText: It is famous for its shabby appearance. While populous, they tend to cluster in set locations.

name: Glameow
flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

name: Houndour
flavorText: It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.

name: Igglybuff
flavorText: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.

name: Illumise
flavorText: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

name: Krabby
flavorText: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

name: Luvdisc
flavorText: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

name: Mankey
flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

name: Mudkip
flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Porygon
flavorText: The world's first artificially created Pokémon. It can travel through electronic space.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

name: Slugma
flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

name: Solrock
flavorText: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

name: Swablu
flavorText: Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone's head, it looks like a cotton hat.

name: Tangela
flavorText: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

name: Togepi
flavorText: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

name: Treecko
flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Unown [L]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Volbeat
flavorText: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE's sweet aroma.

name: Weedle
flavorText: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

name: Whismur
flavorText: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs.  If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

name: Wingull
flavorText: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.

name: Zigzagoon
flavorText: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Glaceon
flavorText: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

name: Kabutops
flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

name: Moltres
flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

name: Phione
flavorText: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Aerodactyl
flavorText: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

name: Espeon
flavorText: Its fur has the look and feel of velvet. The orb on its forehead glows when it uses psycho-power.

name: Flareon
flavorText: It has a flame sac in its body. Its body temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit before battle.

name: Glaceon
flavorText: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: Its huge mouth is almost seven feet across. It has enough power to completely crush a car.

name: Infernape
flavorText: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: It controls 10,000-volt power and can raise all the furs on its body as if it were sharp needles.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

name: Minun
flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Omastar
flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

name: Phione
flavorText: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Scizor
flavorText: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

name: Torterra
flavorText: Groups of this Pokémon migrating in search of water have been mistaken for "moving forests."

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: The toxin made in its poison sacs is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

name: Umbreon
flavorText: The light of the moon changed Eevee's genetic structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.

name: Unown [P]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: It has evolved to be suitable for aquatic life. It can invisibly melt away into water.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

name: Fearow
flavorText: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

name: Grotle
flavorText: The shell is hardened soil. Some Pokémon come to peck the berries growing on the trees on its back.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Monferno
flavorText: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

name: Mothim
flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It lives atop trees.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: Its wings deliver wicked blows that snap even the thickest of trees. It searches for prey in icy seas.

name: Raichu
flavorText: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

name: Scyther
flavorText: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja's.

name: Staravia
flavorText: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: It stands along paths pretending to be a tree. If it starts raining, it seems to disappear.

name: Unown [Q]
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

name: Aipom
flavorText: It lives atop giant trees. It wraps its tail around a branch so it won't fall off while asleep.

name: Aipom
flavorText: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: X-ray photos were taken to check its body structure. Nothing appeared, however.

name: Buneary
flavorText: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
flavorText: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

name: Chatot
flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

name: Chingling
flavorText: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

name: Combee
flavorText: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: It tugs on the hands of children to steal them away. However, it gets pulled around instead.

name: Eevee
flavorText: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

name: Eevee
flavorText: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

name: Electrike
flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Glameow
flavorText: With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

name: Kabuto
flavorText: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

name: Munchlax
flavorText: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

name: Omanyte
flavorText: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

name: Piplup
flavorText: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

name: Shellos East Sea
flavorText: It lives along bodies of water. Its body shape changed to suit its habitat.

name: Spearow
flavorText: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

name: Starly
flavorText: Usually with a large flock, it is barely noticeable when alone. Its cries are very strident.

name: Stunky
flavorText: It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Deoxys Normal Forme
flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Dragonite
flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

name: Froslass
flavorText: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

name: Giratina
flavorText: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Heatran
flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Kingdra
flavorText: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

name: Luxray
flavorText: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

name: Mamoswine
flavorText: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

name: Metagross
flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

name: Politoed
flavorText: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.

name: Probopass
flavorText: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units call Mini-Noses.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Regigigas
flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

name: Armaldo
flavorText: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

name: Azelf
flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

name: Bellossom
flavorText: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

name: Cradily
flavorText: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

name: Crawdaunt
flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

name: Delcatty
flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Deoxys Attack Forme
flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Deoxys Defense Forme
flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Deoxys Speed Forme
flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Ditto
flavorText: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

name: Forretress
flavorText: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

name: Groudon
flavorText: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

name: Heatran
flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Jirachi
flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Kyogre
flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

name: Mesprit
flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

name: Poliwrath
flavorText: With extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

name: Regice
flavorText: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Regigigas
flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Regirock
flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

name: Registeel
flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

name: Shedinja
flavorText: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Unown [!]
flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

name: Uxie
flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

name: Victreebel
flavorText: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

name: Anorith
flavorText: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

name: Camerupt
flavorText: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

name: Castform

name: Exeggutor

name: Gliscor
flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Grumpig
flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

name: Lanturn
flavorText: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

name: Ledian
flavorText: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

name: Marowak
flavorText: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

name: Metang
flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

name: Metang
flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

name: Ninjask
flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

name: Persian
flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

name: Piloswine
flavorText: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

name: Seadra
flavorText: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

name: Starmie
flavorText: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

name: Swalot
flavorText: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

name: Swellow
flavorText: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dive steeply to catch the prey.

name: Tauros
flavorText: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

name: Tentacruel
flavorText: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.

name: Unown [J]
flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

name: Unown [?]

name: Beldum

name: Beldum

name: Bellsprout
flavorText: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.

name: Buneary
flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

name: Corphish
flavorText: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

name: Cubone
flavorText: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

name: Dratini
flavorText: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to strike from the sky. It aims for the prey's face.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to strike from the sky. It aims for the prey's face.

name: Gloom
flavorText: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

name: Gloom
flavorText: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

name: Gulpin
flavorText: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.

name: Horsea
flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

name: Houndour
flavorText: It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.

name: Ledyba
flavorText: It is so timid, it can't move if it isn't with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.

name: Lileep
flavorText: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

name: Nincada
flavorText: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

name: Nosepass
flavorText: Its nose is a magnet. As a result, this Pokémon always keeps its face pointing north.

name: Numel
flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

name: Oddish
flavorText: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

name: Oddish
flavorText: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

name: Poliwhirl
flavorText: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

name: Poochyena
flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Riolu
flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

name: Spoink
flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

name: Staryu
flavorText: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.

name: Swinub
flavorText: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

name: Taillow
flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Tentacool
flavorText: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.

name: Tyrogue
flavorText: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.

name: Weepinbell
flavorText: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.

name: Yanma
flavorText: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

name: Steelix
flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Dusclops
flavorText: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

name: Dusclops
flavorText: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Farfetch'd
flavorText: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

name: Grovyle
flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

name: Machoke
flavorText: Machoke's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

name: Magneton
flavorText: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

name: Magneton
flavorText: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

name: Pichu
flavorText: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

name: Piloswine
flavorText: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Its body is hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

name: Scyther
flavorText: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja's.

name: Shelgon
flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

name: Staravia
flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

name: Bagon
flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

name: Duskull
flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Duskull

name: Finneon
flavorText: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

name: Gastly
flavorText: This Pokémon's body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

name: Machop
flavorText: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

name: Onix
flavorText: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.

name: Roselia
flavorText: Roselia raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

name: Skorupi
flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

name: Snover
flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

name: Starly
flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Stunky
flavorText: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

name: Swinub
flavorText: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

name: Tangela
flavorText: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

name: Treecko
flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Voltorb

name: Voltorb

name: Charmander
flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavorText: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

name: Piplup
flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Buneary
flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

name: Cranidos
flavorText: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

name: Shieldon
flavorText: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

name: Chatot
flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

name: Raichu
flavorText: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

name: Mime Jr.
flavorText: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

name: Glameow
flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness if very popular among some.

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Palkia
flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

name: Drifblim

name: Regigigas
flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Arceus
flavorText: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

name: Dratini
flavorText: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

name: Dratini

name: Dragonair

name: Dragonair
flavorText: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

name: Dragonite
flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

name: Bagon
flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Shelgon
flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

name: Salamence
flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

name: Latias
flavorText: Its body is covered in a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

name: Latios
flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Axew
flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Axew
flavorText: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

name: Fraxure
flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

name: Fraxure
flavorText: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

name: Haxorus
flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Kyurem
flavorText: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

name: Pikachu on the Ball
flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Eevee on the Ball
flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Grookey on the Ball
flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Scorbunny on the Ball
flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Sobble on the Ball
flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Metapod
flavorText: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

name: Paras
flavorText: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

name: Parasect
flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

name: Tangela
flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

name: Pinsir
flavorText: It swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

name: Rapidash
flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Shellder
flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster
flavorText: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Krabby
flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Raichu
flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Zubat
flavorText: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from it mouth.

name: Golbat
flavorText: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal the victim's life force. It lurks in darkness for prey.

name: Gengar
flavorText: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

name: Jynx
flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

name: Diglett
flavorText: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Machop
flavorText: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

name: Machoke
flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavorText: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Geodude
flavorText: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Graveler
flavorText: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

name: Golem
flavorText: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavorText: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

name: Meowth
flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Persian
flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

name: Doduo
flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Dodrio
flavorText: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Tauros
flavorText: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: Running around, climbing trees, playing hide-and-seek! Another wonderful day begins!

name: Shroomish
flavorText: I wonder if I would look a little cuter with a beautiful flower?

name: Charmander
flavorText: My Charmander is so rambunctious! I wonder if we can become good friends?

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: My precious friend who is always with me. I have so many things I want to tell you.

name: Charizard
flavorText: No matter what happens, if we stick together, we can get past it. Forever and ever.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: What a delicious-looking snowman! I think I'll sneak a bite. It's OK…no one's looking, right?

name: Froslass
flavorText: Spring is already here, so goodbye…

name: Raichu
flavorText: The plan for today is to do nothing. My awesome tail is all curled up, and my ears are tired, too.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: Crackle…buzz…Dedenne…?! Beep…

name: Wobbuffet
flavorText: When she's surrounded by cushions and dressers that I like, she looks just like a princess!

name: Gulpin
flavorText: When Mom gets in the kitchen, the happiest things happen. I can feel my mouth watering!

name: Jirachi
flavorText: The twinkle of the stars. The destiny of love. A miracle that grants wishes in the night sky.

name: Espurr
flavorText: My number one. Exceptionally cute. A little princess.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: Intense silence. Two lamplights. Keep waiting for night to end.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: Hidden away in its jet-black wings is a red passion.

name: Flabébé
flavorText: It's OK. No one will take away your flower. You look cute even when you're angry.

name: Floette
flavorText: The five of us team up to be the Pretty Young Girl Force! We'll show you some beautiful moves!

name: Swirlix
flavorText: My fluffy heart makes me feel like a marshmallow. A thrilling macaron full of colorful magic. Everybody's crazy about the taste of candy! ☆

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: The cakes Slurpuff makes always look just like that one Pokémon it likes.

name: Diancie
flavorText: Open the magic door and a dream-colored party will start again today. I'll teach you the secret password.

name: Swablu
flavorText: Wings and beaks. I like yours, and I like mine, too.

name: Altaria
flavorText: This fluffiness makes everyone go crazy. Is it really that charming?

name: Fletchling
flavorText: Little friends, thanks for always helping me look so cute!

name: Pikachu
flavorText: A yellow body is proof of good health. If you touch its bright-red cheeks, you'll see its shining, smiling face!

name: Arcanine
flavorText: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.

name: Azumarill
flavorText: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

name: Clefable
flavorText: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Jumpluff
flavorText: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores—it can even float around the world.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

name: Noctowl
flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

name: Quagsire
flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

name: Raichu
flavorText: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

name: Slowking
flavorText: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

name: Wobbuffet
flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Ariados
flavorText: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.

name: Cleffa
flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an Exeggcute cluster.

name: Farfetch'd
flavorText: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

name: Feraligatr
flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: Furret
flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

name: Granbull
flavorText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

name: Hypno
flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Lapras
flavorText: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

name: Ledian
flavorText: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

name: Meganium
flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

name: Persian
flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

name: Pichu
flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

name: Sandslash
flavorText: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spike and claws. They grow back in a day.

name: Smoochum
flavorText: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

name: Sunflora
flavorText: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

name: Typhlosion
flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: Tyrogue
flavorText: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Weezing
flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

name: Bayleef
flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: Blissey
flavorText: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

name: Corsola
flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

name: Croconaw
flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

name: Donphan
flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

name: Heracross
flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

name: Igglybuff
flavorText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

name: Mantine
flavorText: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

name: Metapod
flavorText: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.

name: Miltank
flavorText: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

name: Parasect
flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

name: Quilava
flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

name: Qwilfish
flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

name: Skiploom
flavorText: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

name: Starmie
flavorText: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

name: Unown
flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Unown
flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a Body Slam.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

name: Chansey
flavorText: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

name: Cyndaquil
flavorText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six Exeggcute.

name: Girafarig
flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Hoothoot
flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Hoppip
flavorText: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

name: Jynx
flavorText: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

name: Ledyba
flavorText: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

name: Mareep
flavorText: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

name: Marill
flavorText: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.

name: Paras
flavorText: As its body grows large, large mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

name: Sentret
flavorText: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

name: Staryu
flavorText: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

name: Sunkern
flavorText: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

name: Totodile
flavorText: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

name: Wooper
flavorText: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

name: Ho-Oh LEGEND
flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

name: Ho-Oh LEGEND
flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

name: Lugia LEGEND
flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Lugia LEGEND
flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: They say that during past strife, Gyarados would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.

name: Jirachi
flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Octillery
flavorText: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Politoed
flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

name: Torterra
flavorText: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

name: Xatu
flavorText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

name: Crobat
flavorText: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

name: Fearow
flavorText: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Kingdra
flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

name: Poliwrath
flavorText: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

name: Primeape
flavorText: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

name: Roserade
flavorText: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

name: Steelix
flavorText: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

name: Tyranitar
flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

name: Ursaring
flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

name: Cherrim
flavorText: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

name: Golbat
flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

name: Grotle
flavorText: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

name: Metang
flavorText: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

name: Minun
flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Numel
flavorText: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Poliwhirl
flavorText: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

name: Seadra
flavorText: Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

name: Tauros
flavorText: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Aipom
flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Beldum
flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

name: Horsea
flavorText: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

name: Magmar
flavorText: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

name: Mankey
flavorText: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

name: Natu
flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

name: Onix
flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Onix
flavorText: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

name: Riolu
flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Roselia
flavorText: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

name: Spearow
flavorText: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

name: Stantler
flavorText: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Tropius
flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Zubat
flavorText: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.

name: Bellossom
flavorText: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Espeon
flavorText: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

name: Forretress
flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Magcargo
flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Scizor
flavorText: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

name: Togekiss
flavorText: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

name: Umbreon
flavorText: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

name: Dodrio
flavorText: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

name: Drifblim
