flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

name: Forretress
flavorText: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Metagross
flavorText: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: Tropius
flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

name: Vespiquen
flavorText: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Weavile
flavorText: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

name: Flareon
flavorText: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Gloom
flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Lairon
flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Metang
flavorText: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

name: Muk
flavorText: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

name: Pinsir
flavorText: With its horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.

name: Raichu
flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Raticate
flavorText: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Scyther
flavorText: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective colors make it invisible.

name: Skuntank
flavorText: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to Shellder's seeping poison.

name: Togetic
flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: Unown
flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

name: Aron
flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Beldum
flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

name: Combee
flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Doduo
flavorText: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Eevee
flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Grimer
flavorText: Wherever Grimer has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

name: Houndour
flavorText: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Houndour
flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Mawile
flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

name: Oddish
flavorText: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day it stays quietly underground.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It hangs and waits for flying insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.

name: Scyther
flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: A sweet sap leaks from its tail's tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.

name: Slugma
flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: Vicious in nature, it drives Pidgey from their nests and scavenges any leftovers it can find.

name: Stunky
flavorText: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

name: Togepi
flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

name: Aggron
flavorText: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.

name: Altaria
flavorText: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

name: Celebi
flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

name: Drapion
flavorText: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

name: Mamoswine
flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

name: Nidoking
flavorText: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can render the victim helpless quite easily.

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

name: Rapidash
flavorText: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.

name: Solrock
flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

name: Venomoth
flavorText: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in hue. If it is light in hue, it causes paralysis.

name: Victreebel
flavorText: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

name: Banette
flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

name: Ditto
flavorText: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

name: Dragonite
flavorText: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

name: Electivire
flavorText: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

name: Elekid
flavorText: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

name: Golduck
flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Grumpig
flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Kricketune
flavorText: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Machamp
flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

name: Nidoqueen
flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

name: Pidgeot
flavorText: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

name: Wailord
flavorText: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

name: Haunter
flavorText: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

name: Lairon
flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

name: Luvdisc
flavorText: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

name: Machoke
flavorText: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.

name: Magby
flavorText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

name: Magmar
flavorText: The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.

name: Magneton
flavorText: The Magnemite are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

name: Marowak
flavorText: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

name: Nidorina
flavorText: It has a calm and caring nature. Because its horn grows slowly, it prefers not to fight.

name: Nidorino
flavorText: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with its horn to inject a powerful poison when it becomes agitated.

name: Pidgeotto
flavorText: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

name: Piloswine
flavorText: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

name: Porygon2
flavorText: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

name: Tentacruel
flavorText: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

name: Unown
flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

name: Weepinbell
flavorText: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.

name: Aipom
flavorText: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

name: Aron
flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Bellsprout
flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.

name: Cubone
flavorText: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.

name: Diglett
flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

name: Dratini
flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

name: Illumise
flavorText: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

name: Kricketot
flavorText: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

name: Machop
flavorText: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavorText: Although not very combative, it will torment its foes with poison spikes if it is threatened in any way.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavorText: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. It will strike first if it senses any danger.

name: Pidgey
flavorText: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.

name: Porygon
flavorText: A manmade Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it's said. It's very active at night.

name: Skorupi
flavorText: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

name: Spoink
flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

name: Swablu
flavorText: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.

name: Swinub
flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Tentacool
flavorText: It drifts aimlessly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.

name: Venonat
flavorText: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches and eats small bugs at night that are attracted by light.

name: Volbeat
flavorText: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Yanma
flavorText: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

name: Ho-Oh
flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind when it flies.

name: Lugia
flavorText: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Wobbuffet
flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Hoothoot
flavorText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

name: Noctowl
flavorText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

name: Latias
flavorText: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Latios
flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Cleffa
flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Smoochum
flavorText: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

name: Lapras
flavorText: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Minun
flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Raikou
flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: Entei
flavorText: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.

name: Suicune
flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Porygon
flavorText: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn't breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment..

name: Porygon2
flavorText: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Maractus
flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Alomomola
flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

name: Munna
flavorText: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

name: Sandile
flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Zorua
flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Klink
flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Pidove
flavorText: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: Audino
flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Servine
flavorText: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

name: Pansage
flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

name: Dwebble
flavorText: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

name: Pignite
flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Dewott
flavorText: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

name: Emolga
flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

name: Woobat
flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Klang
flavorText: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

name: Axew
flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Chespin
flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Inkay
flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Honedge
flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Swirlix
flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Furfrou
flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Treecko
flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Lotad
flavorText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Staryu
flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: Mudkip
flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Electrike
flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

name: Meditite
flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Marill
flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

name: Zigzagoon
flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Totodile
flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

name: Togepi
flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Meowth
flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Grubbin
flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

name: Litten
flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Popplio
flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Cosmog
flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Crabrawler
flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

name: Cutiefly
flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Pikipek
flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

name: Yungoos
flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

name: Horsea
flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

name: Machop
flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

name: Cubone
flavorText: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

name: Dratini
flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

name: Chansey
flavorText: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

name: Porygon
flavorText: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

name: Magmar
flavorText: When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all over its body. It doesn't calm down until its opponent has burned to ash.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavorText: An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

name: Lapras
flavorText: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

name: Mankey
flavorText: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages, and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

name: Onix
flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavorText: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavorText: This Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

name: Treecko
flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Chespin
flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Grookey
flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Cyndaquil
flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Litten
flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Scorbunny
flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Totodile
flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Mudkip
flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Piplup
flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Popplio
flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Sobble
flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Ledyba
flavorText: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Gossifleur
flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

name: Victini
flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Lapras
flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Cutiefly
flavorText: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Bewear
flavorText: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Pangoro
flavorText: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Drampa
flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Oddish
flavorText: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

name: Gloom
flavorText: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

name: Lotad
flavorText: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

name: Lombre
flavorText: It prefers waterfronts with plentiful food. It became nocturnal so it wouldn't have to compete for food with bird Pokémon.

name: Ludicolo
flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Nymble
flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Lokix
flavorText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

name: Moltres
flavorText: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: Charcadet
flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Ceruledge
flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Seel
flavorText: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

name: Swinub
flavorText: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

name: Piloswine
flavorText: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

name: Mamoswine
flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

name: Suicune
flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Piplup
flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

name: Yamper
flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Pawmi
flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavorText: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot
flavorText: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

name: Granbull
flavorText: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Milcery
flavorText: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

name: Alcremie
flavorText: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

name: Zacian
flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Bramblin
flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Brambleghast
flavorText: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavorText: This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent's weak spots.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel- shaped nest.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

name: Flygon
flavorText: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Gastly
flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Seviper
flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Absol
flavorText: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Sandile
flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

name: Toxel
flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

name: Eternatus
flavorText: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Duraludon
flavorText: Duraludon's body is comprised of a special metal that's lightweight and scratch resistant. It's also smooth, as though it was given a mirror finish.

name: Archaludon
flavorText: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Aipom
flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have other members of its species leave paw prints on its back.

name: Zigzagoon
flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

name: Linoone
flavorText: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

name: Buneary
flavorText: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Ludicolo
flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

name: Nymble
flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

name: Piplup
flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Yamper
flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Zacian
flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Flygon
flavorText: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavorText: It's dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

name: Erika's Oddish
flavorText: When it is woken by moonlight, it wanders about. But during the day, it stays still underground.

name: Erika's Gloom
flavorText: It secretes a sticky, drool-like nectar. Though sweet, it smells too repulsive to get very close.

name: Erika's Bellsprout
flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Erika's Weepinbell
flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

name: Erika's Tangela
flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

name: Wurmple
flavorText: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

name: Silcoon
flavorText: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

name: Beautifly
flavorText: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

name: Cascoon
flavorText: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

name: Dustox
flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

name: Budew
flavorText: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

name: Grubbin
flavorText: It spits sticky threads and winds them around branches, then swings nimbly from tree to tree in a pendulum-like motion.

name: Team Rocket's Tarountula
flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

name: Team Rocket's Spidops
flavorText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Ethan's Slugma
flavorText: Its lava body can cool and chip away at times, but a magma bath will heal it right up.

name: Ethan's Magcargo
flavorText: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

name: Entei
flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Numel
flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Camerupt
flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

name: N's Darumaka
flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

name: N's Darmanitan
flavorText: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Salandit
flavorText: Only female Salandit can produce gas laden with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas will do whatever the females tell them.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other’s group.

name: Scorbunny
flavorText: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Raboot
flavorText: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Totodile
flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

name: N's Vanillite
flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: N's Vanillish
flavorText: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

name: Snom
flavorText: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

name: Frosmoth
flavorText: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.

name: Glastrier
flavorText: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: Raichu
flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Charjabug
flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

name: Tapu Koko
flavorText: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Iono's Tadbulb
flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Iono's Wattrel
flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Iono's Kilowattrel
flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

name: Clefable
flavorText: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Team Rocket's Exeggcute
flavorText: Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.

name: Team Rocket's Exeggutor
flavorText: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Togepi
flavorText: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss
flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Marill
flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Ralts
flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

name: Banette
flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Hop's Phantump
flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

name: Hop's Trevenant
flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Spectrier
flavorText: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Munkidori
flavorText: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Team Rocket's Diglett
flavorText: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio
flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Solrock
flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Groudon
flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Cynthia's Gible
flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Cynthia's Gabite
flavorText: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

name: Riolu
flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Pancham
flavorText: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.

name: Rolycoly
flavorText: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon’s body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

name: Carkol
flavorText: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

name: Coalossal
flavorText: It’s gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

name: Okidogi
flavorText: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Gastly
flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Team Rocket's Murkrow
flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Team Rocket's Honchkrow
flavorText: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

name: Poochyena
flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavorText: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavorText: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Cynthia's Spiritomb
flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: N's Zorua
flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

name: Hoopa
flavorText: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

name: Pecharunt
flavorText: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

name: Mawile
flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.

name: Kingambit
flavorText: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

name: Dratini
flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: N's Reshiram
flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: N's Zekrom
flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Noibat
flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

name: Noivern
flavorText: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: Dreepy
flavorText: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

name: Drakloak
flavorText: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they’re all grown up.

name: Team Rocket's Meowth
flavorText: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Larry's Dunsparce
flavorText: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty
flavorText: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Larry's Starly
flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Larry's Staravia
flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

name: Larry's Staraptor
flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Fan Rotom
flavorText: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.

name: Larry's Rufflet
flavorText: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

name: Larry's Braviary
flavorText: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

name: Larry's Komala
flavorText: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala’s drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.

name: Drampa
flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Hop's Cramorant
flavorText: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They’re at their most formidable when they’re struggling to swallow overly large prey.

name: Terapagos
flavorText: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

name: Erika's Tangela
flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Beautifly
flavorText: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

name: Dustox
flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

name: Budew
flavorText: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

name: Ethan's Magcargo
flavorText: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

name: Numel
flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other’s group.

name: Scorbunny
flavorText: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Vikavolt
flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

name: Iono's Wattrel
flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Marill
flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Banette
flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Togekiss
flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Hop's Trevenant
flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio
flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Cynthia's Spiritomb
flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Mawile
flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Dreepy
flavorText: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

name: Drakloak
flavorText: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they’re all grown up.

name: Larry's Staraptor
flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Fan Rotom
flavorText: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Chespin
flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Quilladin
flavorText: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

name: Chesnaught
flavorText: Its tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Ho-Oh
flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Braixen
flavorText: It keeps a twig in its tail. Using friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Delphox
flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Litleo
flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
flavorText: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle filling its body with power and changing its form.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Bergmite
flavorText: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. If the ice breaks, this Pokémon uses cold air to quickly create new ice.

name: Avalugg
flavorText: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its enormous frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Wimpod
flavorText: It's nature's cleaner-it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavorText: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire wool that zaps on impact.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Emolga
flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its patagial membranes and released while it is gliding.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Espurr
flavorText: It keeps its intense psychic power from leaking out by using its ears to cover the organs emitting that power.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Phantump
flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

name: Trevenant
flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavorText: It was recently discovered that the different varieties of Pumpkaboo vary not only in size but also in the size of the souls they collect.

name: Xerneas
