name: Xatu
flavorText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

name: Hoppip
flavorText: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

name: Kabuto
flavorText: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Natu
flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

name: Omanyte
flavorText: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.

name: Sentret
flavorText: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: It spins a web using fine – but durable – thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

name: Tyrogue
flavorText: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Unown [E]
flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Unown [I]
flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Unown [O]
flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Wooper
flavorText: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

name: Blissey
flavorText: Anyone who takes even one bite of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

name: Celebi
flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

name: Crobat
flavorText: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

name: Entei
flavorText: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

name: Ho-oh
flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven colored wings.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Jumpluff
flavorText: Drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

name: Magneton
flavorText: Three Magnemites are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

name: Porygon2
flavorText: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

name: Raikou
flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: Suicune
flavorText: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Aerodactyl
flavorText: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

name: Celebi
flavorText: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

name: Entei
flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Ho-oh
flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Kingdra
flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

name: Lugia
flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Raichu
flavorText: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Raikou
flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Starmie
flavorText: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

name: Suicune
flavorText: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

name: Golbat
flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

name: Graveler
flavorText: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

name: Jynx
flavorText: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

name: Magcargo
flavorText: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

name: Octillery
flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rockhard head.

name: Parasect
flavorText: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushrooms on its back.

name: Piloswine
flavorText: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Seaking
flavorText: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

name: Stantler
flavorText: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

name: Unown [B]
flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Unown [Y]
flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Aipom
flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Farfetch'd
flavorText: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.

name: Geodude
flavorText: It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.

name: Goldeen
flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in the water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Paras
flavorText: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

name: Quagsire
flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

name: Qwilfish
flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Skiploom
flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

name: Slugma
flavorText: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

name: Smoochum
flavorText: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many people like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Staryu
flavorText: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

name: Swinub
flavorText: If it smells something enticing, it dashes headlong off to find the source of the aroma.

name: Unown [K]
flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Zubat
flavorText: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.

name: Shining Gyarados
flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Shining Magikarp
flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

name: Dark Ampharos
flavorText: Its brightly lit tail can be seen for miles in the dark, even by ships on the sea.

name: Dark Crobat
flavorText: Although the wings it has evolved on its feet allow it to fly at high speeds, they unfortunately make it difficult to perch.

name: Dark Donphan
flavorText: The larger its tusks, the higher its status in the herd.

name: Dark Espeon
flavorText: The tips of its split tail quiver whenever it uses its psychic abilities to read its opponent's next move.

name: Dark Feraligatr
flavorText: Its powerful muscles allow it to move at a speed that belies its bulk.

name: Dark Gengar
flavorText: It absorbs the heat in the air around it. If you suddenly feel cold, it's because a Gengar has appeared.

name: Dark Houndoom
flavorText: The flame it breathes is actually a volatile poison it produces internally that ignites when exposed to air.

name: Dark Porygon2
flavorText: Advances in technology have allowed it to evolve. It occasionally displays behavior not found in its programming.

name: Dark Scizor
flavorText: Nothing can withstand the pressure of the vise-like grip of this Pokémon's steel claws.

name: Dark Typhlosion
flavorText: When it's in combat, the air around it shimmers and warps from the intense heat it produces.

name: Dark Tyranitar
flavorText: Its power is such that not even mountains can stand in its way.

name: Light Arcanine
flavorText: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is easily recognized by its large flowing mane.

name: Light Azumarill
flavorText: It curls up its long ears when swimming to prevent water from entering them.

name: Light Dragonite
flavorText: It is said to fly constantly over the sea, looking for people in need of aid.

name: Light Togetic
flavorText: It becomes depressed if it is not near kind-hearted people. Is is able to float in the air without moving its wings.

name: Dark Ariados
flavorText: Wherever it goes, it spins a thread that always leads back to its web.

name: Dark Magcargo
flavorText: The shell on its back comes off easily, exposing the flames running through its body.

name: Dark Omastar
flavorText: Nothing can escape once wrapped in its tentacles, which it uses for self-defense as well as to catch food.

name: Dark Slowking
flavorText: Each time it yawns, the Shellder on its head releases an enzyme that makes it grow even smarter.

name: Dark Ursaring
flavorText: Its keen nose can pick out any scent, even that of food buried deep underground.

name: Light Dragonair
flavorText: The aura it projects from its body has an effect on the surrounding climate and weather.

name: Light Lanturn
flavorText: This Pokémon has evolved its dorsal fin to emit light, which attracts the fish it feeds on.

name: Light Ledian
flavorText: The number of spots on its back increase or decrease depending on the number of stars visible in the night sky.

name: Light Machamp
flavorText: It uses its four arms in combat to unleash a ceaseless flurry of punches.

name: Light Piloswine
flavorText: Its legs are short, but its hooves are wide and flat, allowing it to easily walk over snow.

name: Unown [G]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [H]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [W]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [X]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Chansey
flavorText: It holds its egg carefully when moving so as not to break it. Still, it is fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye.

name: Dark Croconaw
flavorText: It has 49 teeth in its mouth that are constantly replacing themselves. Pull one out, and a new one grows in.

name: Dark Exeggutor
flavorText: If one of its heads falls off, it turns into an Exeggcute, which begins to look for other Exeggcutes using a special form of telepathy.

name: Dark Flaaffy
flavorText: As a result of storing massive amounts of electricity there, it can no longer grow wool on certain areas of its body.

name: Dark Forretress
flavorText: It stays motionless in trees, driving away with flying armored shards from its hard shell any who come close.

name: Dark Haunter
flavorText: It silently hunts its prey in dark rooms.

name: Dark Omanyte
flavorText: This ancient Pokémon possessed 10 tentacles, which it used to swim through the ocean.

name: Dark Pupitar
flavorText: It is encased within a hard shell, yet retains a great deal of mobility—a dangerous combination.

name: Dark Quilava
flavorText: If it turns its back to an opponent, it is a sign that it is getting ready to attack.

name: Dark Wigglytuff
flavorText: This Pokémon has soft, fine hair. When angered, it increases in size and has been known to charge those it considers a threat.

name: Heracross
flavorText: It is normally peaceful, but will attack any who get between it and honey, its favorite food.

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: It has a perfect sense of balance and can lash out with powerful kicks from any position.

name: Houndour
flavorText: When night falls, the air fills with the eerie cries of this Pokémon as it stakes out its territory.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: If puffs its body up like a balloon and sings a lullaby that makes all who hear it fall into a deep sleep.

name: Light Dewgong
flavorText: It has an aerodynamic shape that allows it to swim at great speeds. The colder the water gets, the more active it becomes.

name: Light Flareon
flavorText: It creates its flames by swallowing air into a special pouch within its body, then heating it to over 3000 degrees.

name: Light Golduck
flavorText: The faster it swims, the brighter the glow on its forehead becomes.

name: Light Jolteon
flavorText: It can collect the ambient electrical energy in its cells and expel it in massive bursts.

name: Light Machoke
flavorText: This Pokémon never gets tired, no matter what it does or how hard it works.

name: Light Ninetales
flavorText: It is said that each of its nine tails contains a different magical power.

name: Light Slowbro
flavorText: If the Shellder attached to its tail becomes separated, this Pokémon reverts to a normal Slowpoke.

name: Light Vaporeon
flavorText: If its fins being to vibrate, it is a sign that it will begin raining soon.

name: Light Venomoth
flavorText: It defends itself by flapping its wings at high speed, spreading poisonous powder throughout the air.

name: Light Wigglytuff
flavorText: If two of them brush against each other, they will not be able to separate themselves, as they enjoy touching each other's soft fur too much.

name: Scyther
flavorText: It moves so fast as to be invisible to the naked eye. Even when standing still, its camouflage prevents it from being seen.

name: Togepi
flavorText: Its shell is said to contain happiness itself, which it will share with those who are kind to it.

name: Unown [C]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [P]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [Q]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [Z]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Cyndaquil
flavorText: It is very meek and constantly crouches in a defensive posture. When threatened, it protects itself with the flame on its back.

name: Dark Octillery
flavorText: It likes to sleep in rock caves and will even steal other Octillery's nests.

name: Dratini
flavorText: Large from birth, this Pokémon increases in size throughout its life by regularly shedding its skin.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Its shell is very durable, allowing it to survive even if the shell becomes cracked.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Its gas-like body allows it to enter almost anywhere, but it is vulnerable to high winds.

name: Girafarig
flavorText: Its tail has a brain of its own, which can respond to stimuli such as scents. Many unsuspecting people have been bitten by it.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It spends its days hanging from cliffs, swooping down on any prey it spots from its high vantage point.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: It fears nothing, not even opponents larger than itself.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: Its punches are blindingly fast, but it can only fight for three minutes before tiring and needing to rest.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: It is born deep within the ground and has to burrow its way out.

name: Ledyba
flavorText: Sensitive to cold, Ledyba gather in groups to share warmth when the temperature drops.

name: Light Sunflora
flavorText: Although it is extremely active during the day, it stops moving entirely as soon as the sun sets.

name: Machop
flavorText: When bored, this super-strong Pokémon trains by lifting rocks.

name: Mantine
flavorText: This Pokémon is perfectly adapted to its ocean home. It can gather up enough speed to burst above the water like a whale.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Its soft wool coat captures air, allowing it to remain cool during the summer and warm in the winter.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: It hits people with its nose as a sign of affection but doesn't know its own strength and so sometimes knocks people off their feet.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It waits suspended from tree branches for insects to fly into its mouth, often not moving for hours at a time.

name: Porygon
flavorText: This Pokémon was created by human computer engineering. Its program is only capable of simple action and reaction.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: Although possessed of great mental powers, it doesn't know how to use them.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: It can shoot a burst of water from its mouth to propel itself backward at high speeds, allowing it to flee from surprised enemies.

name: Seel
flavorText: Although clumsy on land, it moves easily through the arctic waters it calls home.

name: Slugma
flavorText: This Pokémon is often seen crawling around in volcanic regions.

name: Sunkern
flavorText: It is very small and powerless. If attacked, the best it can do is flap its leaves in an attempt to frighten away its enemies.

name: Swinub
flavorText: It moves with its sensitive nose pressed to the ground, always searching for food.

name: Totodile
flavorText: Its highly developed jaws are powerful enough to crush anything. Even experienced adult trainers must handle it with great caution.

name: Unown [L]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [S]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [T]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Unown [V]
flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Venonat
flavorText: It possesses a type of radar, which it can use to find the insects it eats for food, even in pitch darkness.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: As it grows older, its white tail changes colors and splits into six different tails. Its body radiates a faint warmth.

name: Shining Celebi
flavorText: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.

name: Shining Charizard
flavorText: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.

name: Shining Kabutops
flavorText: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

name: Shining Mewtwo
flavorText: It uses its highly developed psychic powers to defeat its enemies before they even have time to think.

name: Shining Noctowl
flavorText: It speeds up its thought processes by turning its head around 180 degrees.

name: Shining Raichu
flavorText: If the electricity in its cheeks runs out, it sticks its tail straight up and uses it to collect energy from the air.

name: Shining Steelix
flavorText: If an Onix lives 100 years or more, its skin hardens, eventually becoming even harder than a diamond.

name: Shining Tyranitar
flavorText: It is so powerful, it can knock down a mountain with hust one arm.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur
flavorText: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Radiant Venusaur
flavorText: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavorText: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Charmander
flavorText: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Radiant Charizard
flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Moltres
flavorText: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Numel
flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Camerupt
flavorText: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Radiant Blastoise
flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won't feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won't notice when its tail grows back, either.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Lapras
flavorText: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Articuno
flavorText: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Wimpod
flavorText: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavorText: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Natu
flavorText: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

name: Xatu
flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Sylveon
flavorText: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

name: Onix
flavorText: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

name: Solrock
flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Alolan Rattata
flavorText: Night after night, they sneak into people's homes seeking food. A massive outbreak of them has become an issue of public concern.

name: Alolan Raticate
flavorText: It commands a nest of Rattata. Different nests don't get along, whipping up severe fights over feeding grounds.

name: Tyranitar
flavorText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Steelix
flavorText: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Meltan
flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Melmetal
flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Chansey
flavorText: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It's used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

name: Blissey
flavorText: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.

name: Ditto
flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Eevee
flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Aipom
flavorText: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Bibarel
flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

name: Pidove
flavorText: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

name: Tranquill
flavorText: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

name: Unfezant
flavorText: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

name: Professor's Research
flavorText: Professor Willow

name: Professor's Research
flavorText: Professor Willow

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

name: Slaking
flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

name: Beautifly
flavorText: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

name: Dialga
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga's heart beats.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

name: Giratina
flavorText: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

name: Giratina
flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Golduck
flavorText: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

name: Infernape
flavorText: It uses unique fighting moves with fires on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.

name: Kricketune
flavorText: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

name: Luvdisc
flavorText: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

name: Palkia
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA's every breath.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

name: Torterra
flavorText: Some Pokémon are born on a TORTERRA's back and spend their entire life there.

name: Cacturne
flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

name: Cascoon
flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Combusken
flavorText: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

name: Cranidos
flavorText: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Grotle
flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Lombre
flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Lucario
flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

name: Monferno
flavorText: It skillfully control the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

name: Octillery
flavorText: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: Probopass
flavorText: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Shieldon
flavorText: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

name: Silcoon
flavorText: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

name: Vigoroth
flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Cacnea
flavorText: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive 30 days without water.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Chansey
flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

name: Combee
flavorText: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.

name: Diglett
flavorText: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

name: Electrike
flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Grimer
flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

name: Happiny
flavorText: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others' feet and cause them to stumble.

name: Kricketot
flavorText: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

name: Lapras
flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: When it extends its over-six-foot-long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.

name: Lotad
flavorText: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Nosepass
flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

name: Piplup
flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Poochyena
flavorText: A Pokémon with persistent nature, it chases its prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

name: Ralts
flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the REMORAID is deep in the sea.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Swablu
flavorText: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Tauros
flavorText: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

name: Wurmple
flavorText: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

name: Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain
Team Galactic's Invention G-103 Power Spray
Team Galactic's Invention G-105 Poké Turn
Electabuzz
flavorText: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

name: Scyther
flavorText: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It stops eating only to sleep. It doesn't feel full unless it eats nearly 900 pounds a day.

name: Walrein
flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

name: Lairon
flavorText: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

name: Aron
flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: They swarm any foes that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Kecleon
flavorText: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

name: Munchlax
flavorText: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Munchlax
flavorText: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavorText: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

name: Nidorina
flavorText: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

name: Nidorino
flavorText: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Sealeo
flavorText: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

name: Seedot
flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Shellos East Sea
flavorText: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

name: Shellos West Sea
flavorText: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

name: Spheal
flavorText: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

name: Staryu
flavorText: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Weedle
flavorText: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

name: Team Galactic's Invention G-107 Technical Machine G
Team Galactic's Invention G-109 SP Radar
Pikachu
flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: Flying Pikachu
flavorText: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

name: Surfing Pikachu
flavorText: One summer, a group of Pikachu was found riding the waves at the local beach.

name: Metagross
flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

name: Rhyperior
flavorText: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.

name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Camerupt
flavorText: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

name: Chimecho
flavorText: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

name: Claydol
flavorText: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

name: Dodrio
flavorText: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

name: Lunatone
flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

name: Medicham
flavorText: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.

name: Moltres
flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

name: Parasect
flavorText: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.

name: Primeape
flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

name: Sandslash
flavorText: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

name: Seaking
flavorText: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

name: Shedinja
flavorText: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

name: Solrock
flavorText: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

name: Spinda
flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

name: Wailord
flavorText: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

name: Bibarel
flavorText: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

name: Breloom
flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Cherrim
flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

name: Gabite
flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

name: Ivysaur
flavorText: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

name: Loudred
flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Magmar
flavorText: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

name: Marshtomp
flavorText: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

name: Masquerain
flavorText: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

name: Metang
flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

name: Milotic
flavorText: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

name: Minun
flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

name: Ninjask
flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

name: Numel
flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

name: Pinsir
flavorText: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

name: Rhydon
flavorText: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.

name: Roserade
flavorText: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

name: Staravia
flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

name: Yanma
flavorText: It can hover is one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

name: Beldum
flavorText: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

name: Buneary
flavorText: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

name: Chatot
flavorText: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

name: Chingling
flavorText: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

name: Combee
flavorText: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.

name: Corphish
flavorText: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

name: Doduo
flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

name: Feebas
flavorText: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Geodude
flavorText: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

name: Gible
flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

name: Goldeen
flavorText: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

name: Kricketot
flavorText: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.

name: Mankey
flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

name: Meditite
flavorText: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

name: Mime Jr.
flavorText: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.

name: Mudkip
flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Nincada
flavorText: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Paras
flavorText: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Piplup
flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.

name: Roselia
flavorText: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

name: Seel
flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

name: Shinx
flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

name: Skorupi
flavorText: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.

name: Starly
flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Surskit
flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.

name: Whismur
flavorText: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

name: Zubat
flavorText: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.

name: Articuno
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to freeze the water in the air during winter, causing snow.

name: Moltres
flavorText: The flames on this legendary Pokémon's wings burn so brightly that they can make night seem like day.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to be present wherever there is a lightning storm.

name: Milotic
flavorText: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

name: Yanma
flavorText: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

name: Froslass
flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Heatran
flavorText: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.

name: Kabutops
flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

name: Luxray
flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

name: Mothim
flavorText: While it loves floral honey, it won't gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.

name: Swalot
flavorText: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for more potency.

name: Aerodactyl
flavorText: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

name: Cherrim
flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

name: Gengar
flavorText: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

name: Gengar
flavorText: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

name: Glalie
flavorText: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Omastar
flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

name: Pelipper
flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

name: Pichu
flavorText: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Raticate
flavorText: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

name: Sceptile
flavorText: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

name: Graveler
flavorText: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.

name: Grovyle
flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Grovyle
flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Gulpin
flavorText: Almost all of its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Pelipper
flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

name: Rapidash
flavorText: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.

name: Shelgon
flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
flavorText: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
flavorText: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

name: Wormadam Trash Cloak
flavorText: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

name: Bagon
flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

name: Buneary
flavorText: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

name: Burmy Plant Cloak
flavorText: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
flavorText: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

name: Burmy Trash Cloak
flavorText: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

name: Electrike
flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Electrike
flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

name: Geodude
flavorText: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

name: Gulpin
flavorText: Almost all of its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

name: Kabuto
flavorText: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

name: Nosepass
flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

name: Omanyte
flavorText: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

name: Shinx
flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

name: Tangela
flavorText: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

name: Tangela
flavorText: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

name: Treecko
flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Treecko

name: Wingull
flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

name: Shinx

name: Arceus
flavorText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

name: Arceus
flavorText: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

name: Arceus
flavorText: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

flavorText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

name: Arceus

name: Bastiodon
flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Rampardos
flavorText: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

name: Riolu
flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Staravia
flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Buneary
flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling is rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: It agilely scales cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

name: Piplup
flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Starly
flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

name: Gallade
flavorText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on it elbows.

name: Latias
flavorText: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

name: Latios
flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

name: Mothim
flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fire hair that zaps on impact.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer's feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

name: Stantler
flavorText: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
flavorText: When BURMY evolved, it cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Burmy Plant Cloak
flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Corsola
flavorText: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can't live in polluted waters.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Ralts
flavorText: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.

name: Sentret
flavorText: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

name: Spinda
flavorText: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

name: Heatran
flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Lucario
flavorText: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

name: Luxray
flavorText: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey–even those taking shelter behind a wall.

name: Probopass
flavorText: It exudes strong magnetism from all cover. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

name: Cherrim
flavorText: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

name: Happiny
flavorText: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

name: Piplup
flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Riolu
flavorText: Its body is lithe yet powerful. It can crest three mountains and cross two canyons in one night.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Raichu
flavorText: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

name: Regigigas
flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

name: Gabite
flavorText: It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest. Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It live atop trees.

name: Pichu
flavorText: It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.

name: Buneary
flavorText: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

name: Gible
flavorText: Its nests is small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

name: Piplup
flavorText: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

name: Deerling
flavorText: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

name: Sawsbuck
flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

name: Shelmet
flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

name: Accelgor
flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

name: Virizion
flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Pansear
flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

name: Simisear
flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Lampent
flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott
flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

name: Samurott
flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Basculin
flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

name: Swanna
flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: Vanillish
flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

name: Vanilluxe
flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Joltik
flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Woobat
flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat
flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

name: Yamask
flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Cofagrigus
flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Frillish
flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

name: Roggenrola
flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

name: Boldore
flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

name: Gigalith
flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

name: Sawk
flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

name: Archen
flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

name: Archeops
flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Mienshao
flavorText: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Terrakion
