flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

name: Liepard
flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: Zorua
flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

name: Deino
flavorText: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

name: Ferrothorn
flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

name: Durant
flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

name: Herdier
flavorText: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

name: Tornadus
flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

name: Deerling
flavorText: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

name: Sawsbuck
flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

name: Shelmet
flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

name: Accelgor
flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

name: Virizion
flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Pansear
flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

name: Simisear
flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Lampent
flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott
flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

name: Samurott
flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Basculin
flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

name: Swanna
flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: Vanillish
flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

name: Vanilluxe
flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Joltik
flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Woobat
flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat
flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

name: Yamask
flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Cofagrigus
flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

name: Frillish
flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

name: Roggenrola
flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

name: Boldore
flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

name: Gigalith
flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

name: Sawk
flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

name: Archen
flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

name: Archeops
flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Mienshao
flavorText: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

name: Liepard
flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: Zorua
flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

name: Deino
flavorText: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

name: Ferrothorn
flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

name: Durant
flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

name: Herdier
flavorText: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Mew
flavorText: This Pokémon's body is covered by fine hairs that can be seen only under a microscope.

name: Pidgeot
flavorText: This Pokémon searches for food while flying at Mach 2. Its large claws make fearsome weapons.

name: Onix
flavorText: This Pokémon burrows through the earth at high speed, looking for food. The tunnels it digs are used by Diglett as nests.

name: Togepi
flavorText: This Pokémon is still immature. When threatened, it releases poison from its head and tries to drive its enemies away.

name: Ivysaur
flavorText: A sure sign spring is on its way is when the seed on this Pokémon's back flowers.

name: Raticate
flavorText: This Pokémon sometimes hunts for food in rivers, swimming using the small webs between the toes on its rear legs.

name: Ledyba
flavorText: When it senses enemies approaching, this Pokémon releases an orange fluid from the joints in its legs and flees.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: After lulling its enemies with its large eyes, this Pokémon sings them to sleep with a relaxing melody.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: The poison scales on its wings are waterproof, allowing this Pokémon to be active even on rainy days.

name: Tentacruel
flavorText: This Pokémon attacks its prey with its eighty toxin-producing tentacles.

name: Marill
flavorText: This Pokémon's fur repels water like a duck's feathers, allowing it to stay dry and fluffy even in water.

name: Lapras
flavorText: This gentle Pokémon can understand human language and allows people to ride on its back.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: This Pokémon has a unique cry, as all three of its heads are always talking independently of one another.

name: Slowking
flavorText: Its nonchalant reaction to everything somehow gives this Pokémon an imposing presence.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: This Pokémon uses its six-foot tongue as if it were a hand. The origin of its anaesthetic properties is still a mystery.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: This Pokémon makes a loud jangling noise when it shakes its petals to spread poison powder.

name: Primeape
flavorText: This Pokémon only calms down when there are no other animals or people around—which means no one has ever seen it when it's not angry.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

name: Metapod
flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

name: Paras
flavorText: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

name: Parasect
flavorText: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

name: Pinsir
flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

name: Surskit
flavorText: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its heads. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

name: Masquerain
flavorText: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Dartrix
flavorText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

name: Decidueye
flavorText: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

name: Grubbin
flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

name: Fomantis
flavorText: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

name: Morelull
flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

name: Shiinotic
flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

name: Bounsweet
flavorText: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

name: Steenee
flavorText: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

name: Tsareena
flavorText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mounts where they live.

name: Litten
flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Torracat
flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

name: Incineroar
flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

name: Golduck
flavorText: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who posses one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

name: Poliwhirl
flavorText: It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it's safe.

name: Poliwrath
flavorText: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

name: Shellder
flavorText: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

name: Cloyster
flavorText: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

name: Corsola
flavorText: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

name: Wingull
flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean sure to be is teeming with fish Pokémon.

name: Pelipper
flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

name: Popplio
flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Brionne
flavorText: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards it enemies.

name: Primarina
flavorText: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learning from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

name: Crabominable
flavorText: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

name: Wishiwashi
flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

name: Dewpider
flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: Araquanid
flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: Pyukumuku
flavorText: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

name: Bruxish
flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Charjabug
flavorText: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

name: Vikavolt
flavorText: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

name: Zubat
flavorText: It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.

name: Golbat
flavorText: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.

name: Crobat
flavorText: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can't move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavorText: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

name: Alolan Muk
flavorText: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it's ever eaten.

name: Hypno
flavorText: As a matter of course, it makes anyone it meets fall asleep and has a taste of their dreams. Anyone having a good dream, it carries off.

name: Mareanie
flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

name: Toxapex
flavorText: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

name: Cosmog
flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Cosmoem
flavorText: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.

name: Roggenrola
flavorText: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

name: Boldore
flavorText: It explores caves in search of underground water. It's not comfortable around water, so this Pokémon takes great care in lapping it up.

name: Gigalith
flavorText: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.

name: Crabrawler
flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

name: Passimian
flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

name: Sandygast
flavorText: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

name: Palossand
flavorText: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

name: Alolan Rattata
flavorText: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.

name: Alolan Raticate
flavorText: This gourmet Pokémon is particular about the taste and freshness of its food. Restaurants where Raticate live have a good reputation.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

name: Alolan Persian
flavorText: Its round face and smooth coat—softer than the most high-class velvet—have made this a very popular Pokémon in Alola.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: If they scent the faintest trace of blood, they rush to attack en masse. When alone, they're rather cowardly.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon became a victim of overfishing.

name: Sandile
flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavorText: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

name: Granbull
flavorText: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

name: Cutiefly
flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Ribombee
flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

name: Dratini
flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.

name: Dragonite
flavorText: Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon at your peril, because it will smash everything to smithereens before it's satisfied.

name: Spearow
flavorText: Farmers whose fields are troubled by bug Pokémon appreciate Spearow for its vigorous appetite and look after it.

name: Fearow
flavorText: Drawings of a Pokémon resembling Fearow can be seen in murals from deep in ancient history.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: Kangaskhan's maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

name: Spinda
flavorText: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it's walking in a straight line.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

name: Herdier
flavorText: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed make this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it's a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.

name: Pikipek
flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

name: Trumbeak
flavorText: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of call and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

name: Toucannon
flavorText: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

name: Yungoos
flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

name: Stufful
flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Bewear
flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Oranguru
flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

name: Pheromosa & Buzzwole-GX
subtype: Basic, TAG TEAM, GX, Ultra Beast

name: Caterpie
flavorText: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

name: Metapod
flavorText: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

name: Oddish
flavorText: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Oddish
flavorText: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Venonat
flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

name: Venonat
flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

name: Venomoth
flavorText: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

name: Bellsprout
flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
flavorText: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel
flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

name: Grubbin
flavorText: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.

name: Kartana
flavorText: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: While it's quite friendly toward humans once it's grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

name: Volcanion
flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Litten
flavorText: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Litten
flavorText: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
flavorText: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.

name: Incineroar
flavorText: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

name: Salandit
flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

name: Blacephalon
flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

name: Poliwhirl
flavorText: Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.

name: Poliwrath
flavorText: It's quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.

name: Tentacool
flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

name: Tentacruel
flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.

name: Seel
flavorText: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It's especially fond of Wishiwashi.

name: Krabby
flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
flavorText: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Goldeen
flavorText: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.

name: Seaking
flavorText: Its horn spins like a drill to steadily hollow out rocks—even harder ones. The coloration of the male is more vivid.

name: Kyurem
flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Pyukumuku
flavorText: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Raichu
flavorText: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Charjabug
flavorText: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

name: Vikavolt
flavorText: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

name: Zeraora
flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Ekans
flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok
flavorText: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

name: Zubat
flavorText: It has no eyeballs, so it can't see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

name: Golbat
flavorText: Every once in a while, you'll see a Golbat that's missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.

name: Crobat
flavorText: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won't notice any pain or realize you've been bitten.

name: Gastly
flavorText: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

name: Gastly
flavorText: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

name: Haunter
flavorText: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it's best not to go out walking around.

name: Gengar
flavorText: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.

name: Hypno
flavorText: In Alola, Komala is Hypno's main target. It rarely harms people.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Weezing
flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

name: Mew
flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: What gives meaning to its life is surprising others. If you set your ear against the red orbs around its neck, you can hear shrieking.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

name: Espurr
flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Marshadow
flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.

name: Sandslash
flavorText: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.

name: Diglett
flavorText: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

name: Geodude
flavorText: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

name: Graveler
flavorText: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

name: Golem
flavorText: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

name: Cubone
flavorText: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

name: Marowak
flavorText: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Rhydon
flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Rhyperior
flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Wooper
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
flavorText: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Tyrogue
flavorText: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

name: Landorus
flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Crabrawler
flavorText: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

name: Crabominable
flavorText: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

name: Stakataka
flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

name: Sandile
flavorText: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

name: Sandile
flavorText: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.

name: Greninja
flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Inkay
flavorText: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.

name: Malamar
flavorText: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there's an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavorText: Although it's powerful enough to dig right through volcanic rock, it doesn't allow itself to be seen very often.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavorText: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it's not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.

name: Aron
flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Lairon
flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Aggron
flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Meltan
flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Melmetal
flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Cleffa
flavorText: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!

name: Clefairy
flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

name: Clefable
flavorText: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.

name: Togepi
flavorText: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: Togekiss
flavorText: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

name: Spritzee
flavorText: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

name: Aromatisse
flavorText: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

name: Raticate
flavorText: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

name: Spearow
flavorText: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

name: Fearow
flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Meowth
flavorText: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

name: Persian
flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

name: Doduo
flavorText: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Dodrio
flavorText: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

name: Porygon
flavorText: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

name: Porygon
flavorText: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

name: Porygon2
flavorText: AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn't need to know.

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

name: Glameow
flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

name: Purugly
flavorText: It would claim another Pokémon's nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

name: Happiny
flavorText: Usually it's a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.

name: Chatot
flavorText: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

name: Pheromosa & Buzzwole-GX
subtype: Basic, TAG TEAM, GX, Ultra Beast

name: Pheromosa & Buzzwole-GX
subtype: Basic, TAG TEAM, GX, Ultra Beast

name: Pheromosa & Buzzwole-GX
subtype: Basic, TAG TEAM, GX, Ultra Beast

name: Yanma
flavorText: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

name: Celebi
flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Dwebble
flavorText: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

name: Crustle
flavorText: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

name: Karrablast
flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Foongus
flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

name: Amoonguss
flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

name: Fomantis
flavorText: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

name: Lurantis
flavorText: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.

name: Bounsweet
flavorText: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

name: Steenee
flavorText: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

name: Tsareena
flavorText: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

name: Dhelmise
flavorText: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

name: Magmortar
flavorText: There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.

name: Numel
flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

name: Camerupt
flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Litwick
flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Litwick
flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

name: Salandit
flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

name: Lapras
flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

name: Froslass
flavorText: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

name: Finneon
flavorText: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

name: Lumineon
flavorText: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.

name: Snover
flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

name: Basculin
flavorText: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

name: Tirtouga
flavorText: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.

name: Carracosta
flavorText: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.

name: Cryogonal
flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Dewpider
flavorText: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

name: Araquanid
flavorText: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

name: Wimpod
flavorText: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.

name: Golisopod
flavorText: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.

name: Pyukumuku
flavorText: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

name: Tapu Fini
flavorText: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Alolan Raichu
flavorText: It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it's surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is "hodad."

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

name: Magneton
flavorText: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.

name: Joltik
flavorText: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Eelektross
flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Thundurus
flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Tapu Koko
flavorText: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Xurkitree
flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: It engages its enemies using psychic powers. Each of its three heads fires off psychokinetic energy, tripling its power.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavorText: The rich greenery of the Alola region is hard on Marowak. It controls fire to stay alive.

name: Jynx
flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

name: Wynaut
flavorText: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: There's a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you'll be carried away to the afterlife.

name: Skorupi
flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

name: Uxie
flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

name: Mesprit
flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

name: Azelf
flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

name: Giratina
flavorText: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Munna
flavorText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Musharna
flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Elgyem
flavorText: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.

name: Beheeyem
flavorText: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents' memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.

name: Honedge
flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Honedge
flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Doublade
flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

name: Mareanie
flavorText: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.

name: Toxapex
flavorText: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

name: Salandit
flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

name: Cosmog
flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Necrozma
flavorText: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

name: Poipole
flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Onix
flavorText: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

name: Steelix
flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Cubone
flavorText: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

name: Heracross
flavorText: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

name: Breloom
flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Meditite
flavorText: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

name: Medicham
flavorText: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: Thought to have gone extinct, Relicanth was given a name that is a variation of the name of the person who discovered it.

name: Gible
flavorText: It reacts to anything that moves—flies right at it and bites it. Sometimes it injures itself, but it doesn't care too much.

name: Gabite
flavorText: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Archen
flavorText: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.

name: Archeops
flavorText: This ancient Pokémon's plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavorText: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.

name: Drapion
flavorText: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

name: Hoopa
flavorText: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

name: Escavalier
flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

name: Whimsicott
flavorText: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.

name: Dratini
flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

name: Dratini
flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

name: Dragonite
flavorText: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

name: Latias
flavorText: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Axew
flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Fraxure
flavorText: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

name: Haxorus
flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.

name: Noibat
flavorText: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.

name: Noivern
flavorText: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

name: Tauros
flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

name: Hoothoot
flavorText: Every day, it tilts its head in the same rhythm. A long time ago, people raised these Pokémon to serve as clocks.

name: Noctowl
flavorText: With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it "the emperor of dark nights."

name: Slakoth
flavorText: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Vigoroth
flavorText: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

name: Slaking
flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Bibarel
flavorText: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

name: Munchlax
flavorText: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.

name: Pidove
flavorText: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

name: Tranquill
flavorText: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

name: Unfezant
flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

name: Audino
flavorText: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

name: Tornadus
flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: While it's an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you'll be burned.

name: Yungoos
flavorText: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.

name: Gumshoos
flavorText: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.

name: Oranguru
flavorText: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

name: Type: Null
flavorText: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Silvally
flavorText: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

name: Komala
flavorText: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

name: Metapod
flavorText: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

name: Paras
flavorText: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

name: Scyther
flavorText: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

name: Psyduck
flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

name: Staryu
flavorText: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

name: Lapras
flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

name: Jolteon
flavorText: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

name: Ekans
flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Ekans
flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok
flavorText: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Weezing
flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

name: Jynx
flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

name: Mew
flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Geodude
flavorText: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

name: Graveler
flavorText: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

name: Golem
flavorText: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

name: Cubone
flavorText: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

name: Clefable
