flavorText: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

name: Farfetch'd
flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

name: Chansey
flavorText: It seems that other Pokémon's efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

name: Eevee
flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

name: Oddish
flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

name: Sunkern
flavorText: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

name: Sunflora
flavorText: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon's face become more vivid and lively.

name: Heracross
flavorText: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

name: Lileep
flavorText: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.

name: Cradily
flavorText: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.

name: Tropius
flavorText: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.

name: Kricketot
flavorText: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

name: Kricketune
flavorText: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

name: Deerling
flavorText: Their coloring changes according to the season and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

name: Sawsbuck
flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavorText: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

name: Decidueye
flavorText: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

name: Buzzwole
flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

name: Rapidash
flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Flareon
flavorText: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

name: Slugma
flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Entei
flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Litleo
flavorText: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavorText: If you carelessly approach it because it's cute, the boss of the pack, Ninetales, will appear and freeze you.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

name: Golduck
flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

name: Weavile
flavorText: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.

name: Wailord
flavorText: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

name: Glalie
flavorText: It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.

name: Spheal
flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

name: Spheal
flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

name: Sealeo
flavorText: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

name: Walrein
flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

name: Kyogre
flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

name: Piplup
flavorText: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

name: Phione
flavorText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

name: Tympole
flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna
flavorText: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Black Kyurem
flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Wishiwashi
flavorText: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

name: Dewpider
flavorText: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

name: Araquanid
flavorText: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Raichu
flavorText: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

name: Magneton
flavorText: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn's bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Weezing
flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

name: Natu
flavorText: Although it still can't fly, its jumping power is outstanding. It jumps way up into trees and plucks the buds from the branches.

name: Xatu
flavorText: It's said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it's not powerful enough to change the future it sees.

name: Ralts
flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Gallade
flavorText: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

name: Duskull
flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Dusclops
flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Woobat
flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat
flavorText: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

name: Golett
flavorText: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.

name: Golurk
flavorText: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master's orders faithfully.

name: Skrelp
flavorText: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.

name: Dragalge
flavorText: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.

name: Phantump
flavorText: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It's trying to make friends with them.

name: Trevenant
flavorText: It's feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

name: Dhelmise
flavorText: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

name: Cosmog
flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Cosmog
flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Cosmoem
flavorText: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the "cocoon of the stars" and built an altar to worship it.

name: Lunala
flavorText: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name "the beast that calls the moon."

name: Marshadow
flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

name: Blacephalon
flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Onix
flavorText: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

name: Nosepass
flavorText: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it's in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.

name: Anorith
flavorText: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don't thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.

name: Armaldo
flavorText: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.

name: Groudon
flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Seismitoad
flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

name: Throh
flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

name: Pancham
flavorText: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.

name: Pangoro
flavorText: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

name: Crabrawler
flavorText: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

name: Crabominable
flavorText: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

name: Rockruff
flavorText: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

name: Lycanroc
flavorText: It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn't like. It doesn't seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.

name: Passimian
flavorText: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

name: Sandygast
flavorText: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

name: Palossand
flavorText: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavorText: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavorText: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

name: Alolan Muk
flavorText: There are over a hundred kinds of poison inside its body. Chemical reactions between different poisons are the source of its vitality.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

name: Absol
flavorText: The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it's said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.

name: Guzzlord
flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavorText: After fleeing a volcanic eruption, it ended up moving to an area of snowy mountains. Its ice shell is as hard as steel.

name: Alolan Sandslash
flavorText: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

name: Steelix
flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Mawile
flavorText: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.

name: Probopass
flavorText: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.

name: Solgaleo
flavorText: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavorText: The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain's base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.

name: Azurill
flavorText: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

name: Whimsicott
flavorText: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

name: Flabébé
flavorText: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

name: Flabébé
flavorText: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

name: Floette
flavorText: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.

name: Florges
flavorText: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.

name: Swirlix
flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Sylveon
flavorText: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.

name: Naganadel & Guzzlord-GX
subtype: Basic, TAG TEAM, GX, Ultra Beast

name: Drampa
flavorText: If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully's house and burn it to the ground.

name: Jangmo-o
flavorText: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

name: Jangmo-o
flavorText: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

name: Hakamo-o
flavorText: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.

name: Kommo-o
flavorText: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.

name: Ultra Necrozma
flavorText: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

name: Eevee
flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

name: Eevee
flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

name: Igglybuff
flavorText: It's always practicing its singing because it wants to improve. Even when it's asleep, it keeps singing in its dreams!

name: Aipom
flavorText: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

name: Ursaring
flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

name: Zangoose
flavorText: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can't defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.

name: Herdier
flavorText: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can't easily penetrate it.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.

name: Braviary
flavorText: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it's considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Stufful
flavorText: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Bewear
flavorText: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.

name: Type: Null
flavorText: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Naganadel & Guzzlord-GX
subtype: Basic, TAG TEAM, GX, Ultra Beast

name: Naganadel & Guzzlord-GX
subtype: Basic, TAG TEAM, GX, Ultra Beast

name: Torkoal
flavorText: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

name: Weavile
flavorText: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

name: Piplup
flavorText: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

name: Wishiwashi
flavorText: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Gallade
flavorText: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

name: Excadrill
flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Steelix
flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

name: Naganadel & Guzzlord-GX
subtype: Basic, TAG TEAM, GX, Ultra Beast

name: Bellsprout
flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
flavorText: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel
flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Petilil
flavorText: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.

name: Lilligant
flavorText: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

name: Phantump
flavorText: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.

name: Trevenant
flavorText: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.

name: Wimpod
flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Golisopod
flavorText: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Litwick
flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Oricorio
flavorText: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

name: Salandit
flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: Turtonator
flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

name: Alolan Sandslash
flavorText: Fleeing a volcanic eruption, it settled on a snowy mountain. As it races through the snowfields, it sends up a spray of snow.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Tentacool
flavorText: They can be found lying dehydrated on beaches, but they are often still alive. When soaked in water, they will revive.

name: Tentacruel
flavorText: Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.

name: Politoed
flavorText: They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.

name: Delibird
flavorText: Although it naturally prefers colder locales, Delibird in Alola seem able to withstand the heat to a certain extent.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.

name: Wailord
flavorText: Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their large mouths, they can swallow entire schools of Wishiwashi whole.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.

name: Glalie
flavorText: Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.

name: Vanillish
flavorText: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.

name: Vanilluxe
flavorText: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.

name: Alomomola
flavorText: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

name: Wishiwashi
flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

name: Mareanie
flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavorText: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavorText: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

name: Alolan Golem
flavorText: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Oricorio
flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder's poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Oricorio
flavorText: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

name: Oricorio
flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by horror and died of the shock.

name: Dhelmise
flavorText: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

name: Lunala
flavorText: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

name: Machop
flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

name: Machop
flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

name: Machoke
flavorText: As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.

name: Machamp
flavorText: It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Nosepass
flavorText: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

name: Barboach
flavorText: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

name: Whiscash
flavorText: A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.

name: Pancham
flavorText: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

name: Mudbray
flavorText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

name: Mudsdale
flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: Minior
flavorText: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, "Get home before the Murkrow fly."

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It's a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.

name: Absol
flavorText: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.

name: Pangoro
flavorText: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

name: Beldum
flavorText: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Metang
flavorText: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

name: Probopass
flavorText: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.

name: Solgaleo
flavorText: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.

name: Clefable
flavorText: They don't like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

name: Whimsicott
flavorText: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

name: Comfey
flavorText: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

name: Goomy
flavorText: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it's unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.

name: Sliggoo
flavorText: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.

name: Goodra
flavorText: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.

name: Drampa
flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it will completely destroy its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Jangmo-o
flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

name: Hakamo-o
flavorText: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

name: Chansey
flavorText: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

name: Blissey
flavorText: Even the most ferocious Pokémon become calm when they eat Blissey's egg, which is said to be filled with happiness.

name: Taillow
flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Swellow
flavorText: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

name: Castform
flavorText: It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.

name: Stufful
flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Bewear
flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Komala
flavorText: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

name: Metapod
flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

name: Oddish
flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

name: Ledyba
flavorText: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

name: Ledian
flavorText: While it's believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

name: Heracross
flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

name: Pansage
flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

name: Simisage
flavorText: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

name: Dewpider
flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: Araquanid
flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: Wimpod
flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Pansear
flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

name: Simisear
flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

name: Turtonator
flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavorText: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

name: Horsea
flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Seadra
flavorText: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

name: Kingdra
flavorText: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.

name: Marill
flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill
flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.

name: Panpour
flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

name: Simipour
flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

name: Bruxish
flavorText: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Raichu
flavorText: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.

name: Electivire
flavorText: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Eelektross
flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

name: Slowking
flavorText: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.

name: Wobbuffet
flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

name: Seviper
flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

name: Duskull
flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Dusclops
flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

name: Venipede
flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

name: Whirlipede
flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

name: Scolipede
flavorText: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

name: Espurr
flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.

name: Sandygast
flavorText: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

name: Palossand
flavorText: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Rhydon
flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Rhyperior
flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

name: Solrock
flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

name: Lucario
flavorText: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

name: Sawk
flavorText: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

name: Crabrawler
flavorText: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

name: Crabominable
flavorText: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

name: Lycanroc
flavorText: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

name: Lycanroc
flavorText: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

name: Mudbray
flavorText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

name: Mudsdale
flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: Passimian
flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

name: Alolan Rattata
flavorText: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

name: Alolan Raticate
flavorText: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavorText: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

name: Inkay
flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Malamar
flavorText: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: Ralts
flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Diancie
flavorText: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Cutiefly
flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Ribombee
flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

name: Morelull
flavorText: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Shiinotic
flavorText: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.

name: Persian
flavorText: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.

name: Porygon
flavorText: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.

name: Porygon2
flavorText: For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

name: Hoothoot
flavorText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

name: Noctowl
flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

name: Bouffalant
flavorText: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

name: Noibat
flavorText: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: Stufful
flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Bewear
flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

name: Ivysaur
flavorText: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

name: Venusaur
flavorText: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Breloom
flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Virizion
flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

name: Shining Genesect
flavorText: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

name: Litten
flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Torracat
flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

name: Incineroar
flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

name: Totodile
flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr
flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Qwilfish
flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

name: Palkia
flavorText: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Shining Volcanion
flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

name: Raikou
flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Minun
flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

name: Ekans
flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

name: Arbok
flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

name: Jynx
flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

name: Shining Mew
flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Latios
flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

name: Shining Jirachi
flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

name: Golett
flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: Golurk
flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Marshadow
flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

name: Zorua
flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

name: Hoopa
flavorText: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

name: Shining Rayquaza
flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Shining Arceus
flavorText: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

name: Cacnea
flavorText: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

name: Cacturne
flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

name: Karrablast
flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Shelmet
flavorText: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

name: Accelgor
flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

name: Skiddo
flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: Gogoat
flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavorText: The bones it possesses were once its mother's. Its mother's regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

name: Numel
flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

name: Camerupt
flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Staryu
flavorText: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.

name: Starmie
flavorText: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

name: Swinub
flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Piloswine
flavorText: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

name: Mamoswine
flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

name: Octillery
flavorText: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

name: Corphish
flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Crawdaunt
flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

name: Feebas
flavorText: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.

name: Milotic
flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Regice
flavorText: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.

name: Shellos
flavorText: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Alolan Raichu
flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavorText: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavorText: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

name: Emolga
flavorText: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.

name: Gengar
flavorText: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.

name: Spoink
flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

name: Grumpig
flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

name: Chimecho
flavorText: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavorText: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Gourgeist
flavorText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: Salandit
flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: Oranguru
flavorText: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

name: Mankey
flavorText: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

name: Primeape
flavorText: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

name: Cubone
flavorText: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

name: Regirock
flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

name: Gastrodon
flavorText: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

name: Stufful
flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Bewear
flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Houndour
flavorText: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

name: Deino
flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Mawile
flavorText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Aron
flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Lairon
flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Aggron
flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

name: Registeel
flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

name: Escavalier
flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you'll become sleepy right away.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.

name: Xerneas
flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Jangmo-o
flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

name: Hakamo-o
flavorText: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

name: Kommo-o
flavorText: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

name: Miltank
flavorText: Its milk is high in calories and packed with nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it, you may wind up with a body like Miltank's.

name: Swablu
flavorText: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

name: Altaria
flavorText: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

name: Starly
flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Staravia
flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

name: Staraptor
flavorText: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

name: Regigigas
flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Regigigas
flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Minccino
flavorText: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Diggersby
flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: Type: Null
flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

name: Yanma
flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Roselia
flavorText: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

name: Roserade
flavorText: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Grotle
flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

name: Torterra
flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

name: Cherrim
flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Mow Rotom
flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Dewpider
flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: Araquanid
flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: Magmar
flavorText: When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all over its body. It doesn't calm down until its opponent has burned to ash.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: From its arm, it launches fireballs hotter than 3,500 degrees Fahrenheit. Its arm starts to melt when it fires a whole barrage.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Monferno
flavorText: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

name: Infernape
flavorText: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Heat Rotom
flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Salandit
flavorText: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

name: Turtonator
flavorText: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavorText: An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

name: Alolan Sandslash
flavorText: This Pokémon's steel spikes are sheathed in ice. Stabs from these spikes cause deep wounds and severe frostbite as well.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Piplup
flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Piplup
flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

name: Snover
flavorText: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

name: Abomasnow
