flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

name: Wash Rotom
flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Frost Rotom
flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.

name: Electivire
flavorText: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: If for some reason its body bursts, its soul spills out with a screaming sound.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

name: Skorupi
flavorText: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

name: Drapion
flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Giratina ◇
flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Cosmog
flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Cosmoem
flavorText: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

name: Lunala ◇
flavorText: Said to live in another world, this Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

name: Cranidos
flavorText: In rock layers where Cranidos fossils are found, the fossilized trunks of trees snapped in two are also often found.

name: Rampardos
flavorText: Records exist of a revived fossil that evolved into Rampardos. It proceeded to escape and then destroy a skyscraper with a headbutt.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

name: Lucario
flavorText: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

name: Passimian
flavorText: They battle with hard berries for weapons. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: Seen as a symbol of bad luck, it's generally disliked. Yet it gives presents—objects that sparkle or shine—to Trainers it's close to.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: If its Murkrow cronies fail to catch food for it, or if it feels they have betrayed it, it will hunt them down wherever they are and punish them.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They dwell in cold places. This Pokémon's main food source in Alola is Vulpix and Sandshrew, which they carefully divide among their group.

name: Stunky
flavorText: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

name: Skuntank
flavorText: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

name: Darkrai ◇
flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavorText: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavorText: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

name: Magneton
flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Shieldon
flavorText: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, so it's thought.

name: Bastiodon
flavorText: It lived in the same environments as Rampardos. Their fossils have been found together—seemingly from after they'd fought to the finish.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

name: Heatran
flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Solgaleo ◇
flavorText: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.

name: Magearna
flavorText: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

name: Morelull
flavorText: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Shiinotic
flavorText: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

name: Tapu Lele
flavorText: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavorText: Alola is the best environment for this Pokémon. Local people take pride in its appearance, saying this is how Exeggutor ought to look.

name: Gible
flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gible
flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

name: Buneary
flavorText: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

name: Glameow
flavorText: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

name: Purugly
flavorText: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

name: Fan Rotom
flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Yungoos
flavorText: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.

name: Gumshoos
flavorText: It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it's diurnal, it never encounters them. This Pokémon boasts incredible patience.

name: Oranguru
flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

name: Type: Null
flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

name: Drampa
flavorText: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Six of them together form a full-fledged Pokémon. It's often hunted by Crabrawler, but uses psychokinesis to drive it off.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

name: Snover
flavorText: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

name: Scatterbug
flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Scatterbug
flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
flavorText: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Vivillon
flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Skiddo
flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Pheromosa
flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavorText: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

name: Heatran
flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degree Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Litleo
flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Clauncher
flavorText: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

name: Clawitzer
flavorText: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

name: Amaura
flavorText: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

name: Aurorus
flavorText: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack.

name: Bergmite
flavorText: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

name: Avalugg
flavorText: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

name: Volcanion ◇
flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Dewpider
flavorText: When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

name: Araquanid
flavorText: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

name: Magneton
flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

name: Xurkitree
flavorText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Uxie
flavorText: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

name: Mesprit
flavorText: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

name: Azelf
flavorText: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

name: Espurr
flavorText: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

name: Honedge
flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Honedge
flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Doublade
flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

name: Inkay
flavorText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

name: Malamar
flavorText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

name: Skrelp
flavorText: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

name: Dragalge
flavorText: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

name: Hoopa
flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Poipole
flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Cubone
flavorText: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

name: Torterra
flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

name: Infernape
flavorText: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Gible
flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Pancham
flavorText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

name: Binacle
flavorText: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

name: Barbaracle
flavorText: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

name: Tyrunt
flavorText: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.

name: Tyrantrum
flavorText: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: This is Zygarde's form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

name: Diancie ◇
flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

name: Lycanroc
flavorText: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

name: Buzzwole
flavorText: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

name: Pangoro
flavorText: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

name: Guzzlord
flavorText: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

name: Flabébé
flavorText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

name: Flabébé
flavorText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

name: Floette
flavorText: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

name: Florges
flavorText: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

name: Sylveon
flavorText: When this Pokémon sights its prey, it swirls its ribbonlike feelers as a distraction. A moment later, it pounces.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

name: Klefki
flavorText: It inserts its horn into chinks in metal, absorbing metal ions. For some reason, it collects keys.

name: Goomy
flavorText: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

name: Goomy
flavorText: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

name: Sliggoo
flavorText: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

name: Goodra
flavorText: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

name: Arceus ◇
flavorText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

name: Diggersby
flavorText: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

name: Furfrou
flavorText: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.

name: Noibat
flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

name: Noivern
flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.

name: Bellsprout
flavorText: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Weepinbell
flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

name: Victreebel
flavorText: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

name: Scyther
flavorText: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

name: Ariados
flavorText: It spins thread from both its rear and its mouth. Then it wraps its prey up in thread and sips their bodily fluids at its leisure.

name: Treecko
flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Treecko
flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Grovyle
flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Sceptile
flavorText: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

name: Sceptile
flavorText: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

name: Seedot
flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Seedot
flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Surskit
flavorText: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its head. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

name: Masquerain
flavorText: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

name: Volbeat
flavorText: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

name: Illumise
flavorText: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

name: Cacnea
flavorText: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Cacturne
flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

name: Tropius
flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

name: Dhelmise
flavorText: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

name: Slugma
flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Combusken
flavorText: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: If the fire burning within its shell goes out, it will die. Those who wish to raise one in their home must always keep something flammable at hand.

name: Oricorio
flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.

name: Mudkip
flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Mudkip
flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Marshtomp
flavorText: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

name: Swampert
flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

name: Lotad
flavorText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

name: Lombre
flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Ludicolo
flavorText: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Wailord
flavorText: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

name: Clamperl
flavorText: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

name: Huntail
flavorText: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

name: Gorebyss
flavorText: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

name: Luvdisc
flavorText: Loving couples have a soft spot for this Pokémon, so honeymoon hotels often release this Pokémon into their pools.

name: Regice
flavorText: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Kyogre
flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Electrike
flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Minun
flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Oricorio
flavorText: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.

name: Gulpin
flavorText: There is nothing its stomach can't digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

name: Swalot
flavorText: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.

name: Spoink
flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

name: Grumpig
flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Solrock
flavorText: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

name: Banette
flavorText: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Lunala
flavorText: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

name: Onix
flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Donphan
flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Meditite
flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Medicham
flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

name: Claydol
flavorText: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

name: Regirock
flavorText: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

name: Groudon
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Minior
flavorText: Strong impacts can knock it out of its shell. This Pokémon was born from mutated nanoparticles.

name: Alolan Rattata
flavorText: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.

name: Tyranitar
flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

name: Sableye
flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

name: Steelix
flavorText: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

name: Mawile
flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Beldum
flavorText: With magnetic traction, it pulls its opponents in close. When they're in range, it slashes them with its rear claws.

name: Beldum
flavorText: With magnetic traction, it pulls its opponents in close. When they're in range, it slashes them with its rear claws.

name: Metang
flavorText: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

name: Metagross
flavorText: A linkage of two Metang, this Pokémon can perform any calculation in a flash by utilizing parallel processing in its four brains.

name: Registeel
flavorText: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.

name: Jirachi ◇
flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Heatran
flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Solgaleo
flavorText: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

name: Celesteela
flavorText: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

name: Kartana
flavorText: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

name: Bagon
flavorText: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

name: Bagon
flavorText: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

name: Shelgon
flavorText: They lurk deep within caves—motionless, neither eating nor drinking. Why they don't die is not known.

name: Salamence
flavorText: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up the fields it passes over.

name: Latias ◇
flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

name: Latios ◇
flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

name: Wingull
flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean is sure to be teeming with fish Pokémon.

name: Pelipper
flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

name: Vigoroth
flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

name: Slaking
flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Whismur
flavorText: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

name: Whismur
flavorText: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

name: Loudred
flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Exploud
flavorText: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor—or like an earthquake has struck.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Kecleon
flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

name: Charmander
flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

name: Charizard
flavorText: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Combusken
flavorText: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Blaziken
flavorText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

name: Victini ◇
flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

name: Litten
flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Salandit
flavorText: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

name: Horsea
flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

name: Horsea
flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

name: Seadra
flavorText: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: Its reckless leaps make it easy pickings for predators. On the bright side, many Pokémon enjoy longer life spans, thanks to Magikarp.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: There are people who swear that any place Gyarados appears is fated for destruction.

name: Lapras
flavorText: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

name: Totodile
flavorText: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

name: Croconaw
flavorText: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

name: Feraligatr
flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: Wooper
flavorText: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

name: Quagsire
flavorText: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

name: Corsola
flavorText: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

name: Feebas
flavorText: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

name: Milotic
flavorText: It lives at the bottom of clear lakes. In times of war, it shows itself, which soothes people's minds and hearts.

name: Phione
flavorText: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Wishiwashi
flavorText: It's awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: As it digs through the sand, its giant jaws crush any rocks that obstruct its path. It builds a funnel-shaped nest.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Dratini
flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

name: Dratini
flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

name: Flygon
flavorText: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

name: Altaria
flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Altaria
flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Bagon
flavorText: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

name: Shelgon
flavorText: They lurk deep within caves—motionless, neither eating nor drinking. Why they don't die is not known.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

name: Kyurem
flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

name: Turtonator
flavorText: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.

name: Drampa
flavorText: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

name: Jangmo-o
flavorText: They live in mountains where no trace of humans can be detected. Jangmo-o grow little by little as they battle one another.

name: Hakamo-o
flavorText: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder and sharper each time they're regrown.

name: Kommo-o
flavorText: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other commodities.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: The child in its pouch leaves home after roughly three years. That is the only time the mother is heard to cry wildly.

name: Swablu
flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Swablu
flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Tangela
flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

name: Scyther
flavorText: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

name: Pinsir
flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

name: Bayleef
flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

name: Meganium
flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

name: Ariados
flavorText: It spins thread from both its rear and its mouth. Then it wraps its prey up in thread and sips their bodily fluids at its leisure.

name: Hoppip
flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Hoppip
flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Skiploom
flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

name: Jumpluff
flavorText: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Heracross
flavorText: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

name: Celebi ◇
flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

name: Treecko
flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Grovyle
flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Wurmple
flavorText: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Wurmple
flavorText: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Silcoon
flavorText: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

name: Beautifly
flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

name: Cascoon
flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Dustox
flavorText: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

name: Nincada
flavorText: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

name: Ninjask
flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

name: Combee
flavorText: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

name: Vespiquen
flavorText: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Skiddo
flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Tapu Bulu
flavorText: The guardian deity of Ula'ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes and then deals them a savage blow with its horns.

name: Moltres
flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

name: Cyndaquil
flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

name: Cyndaquil
flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

name: Quilava
flavorText: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

name: Typhlosion
flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: Slugma
flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Houndour
flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

name: Entei
flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Heatran
flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Victini
flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Litleo
flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavorText: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

name: Slowking
flavorText: This Pokémon is so famed for its intellect that a proverb still persists in some regions: "When in doubt, ask Slowking."

name: Lapras
flavorText: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

name: Mantine
flavorText: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

name: Suicune
flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

name: Beartic
flavorText: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

name: White Kyurem
flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Popplio
flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Popplio
flavorText: This Pokémon can control water bubbles. It practice diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

name: Brionne
flavorText: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.

name: Primarina
flavorText: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokémon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.

name: Mareanie
flavorText: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

name: Toxapex
flavorText: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

name: Bruxish
flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.

name: Electivire
flavorText: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Mareep
flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

name: Mareep
flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Raikou
flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

name: Tapu Koko
flavorText: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

name: Natu
flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

name: Xatu
flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Espeon
flavorText: It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb grows dull and dark.

name: Unown
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

name: Unown
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

name: Unown
flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

name: Wobbuffet
flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it live quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Girafarig
flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

name: Shedinja
flavorText: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

name: Sableye
flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

name: Giratina
flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Yamask
flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Cofagrigus
flavorText: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Lampent
flavorText: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feels of those who hear it.

name: Mareanie
flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

name: Nihilego
flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts, it's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

name: Poipole
flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Naganadel
flavorText: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

name: Onix
flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: Apparently, the larger the green parts of this Pokémon, the more collectors value it. It's a particular favorite among elderly people.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Donphan
flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you'd like.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Carbink
flavorText: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavorText: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

name: Alolan Persian
flavorText: It looks down on everyone other than itself. Its preferred tactics are sucker punches and blindside attacks.

name: Umbreon
flavorText: With its black fur, it blends into the darkness. It bides its time, and when prey appears, this Pokémon goes for its threat, and then eats it.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavorText: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavorText: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

name: Forretress
flavorText: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters piece of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Steelix
flavorText: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

name: Scizor
flavorText: Once it has identified an enemy, this Pokémon smashes it mercilessly with pincers hard as steel.

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Durant
flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

name: Magearna
flavorText: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: Jigglypuff posses a vocal range that exceeds 12 octaves, but each individual's singing skill depends on its own effort.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: As it inhales, it expands…and expands…and expands. Wigglytuff compete to see which one can inflate itself the most.

name: Marill
flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

name: Azumarill
flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

name: Granbull
flavorText: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

name: Ralts
flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: It has a psychic power that enabled it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

name: Carbink
flavorText: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

name: Xerneas ◇
flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Cutiefly
flavorText: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.

name: Ribombee
flavorText: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.

name: Morelull
flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

name: Shiinotic
flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

name: Tapu Lele
flavorText: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

name: Tapu Fini
flavorText: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

name: Chansey
flavorText: Not only are these Pokémon fast runners, they're also few in number, so anyone who finds one must be lucky indeed.

name: Blissey
flavorText: Its fluffy fur coat acts as a sensor, enabling it to read the feelings of people and Pokémon.

name: Ditto ◇
flavorText: With its astonishing capacity for metamorphosis, it can get along with anything. It does not get along well with its fellow Ditto.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

name: Stantler
flavorText: The curved antlers change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: It draws symbols all over the place to mark its territory. In towns with many Smeargle, the walls are covered in graffiti.

name: Miltank
flavorText: Most people raise it for its milk, but it's quite tough and strong, so it's also well suited for battle.

name: Ho-Oh
flavorText: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

name: Kecleon
flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

name: Kecleon
flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

name: Pikipek
flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

name: Pikipek
flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

name: Trumbeak
flavorText: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

name: Toucannon
flavorText: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

name: Paras
flavorText: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

name: Parasect
flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

name: Pinsir
flavorText: It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.

name: Shaymin ◇
flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it's not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

name: Rapidash
flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Moltres
flavorText: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

name: Litten
flavorText: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.

name: Torracat
flavorText: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

name: Golduck
flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

name: Staryu
flavorText: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called "the deity of destruction."

name: Lapras
flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavorText: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the "fireworks of the earth."

name: Alolan Golem
flavorText: It's grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Mareep
flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Emolga
flavorText: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.

name: Joltik
flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

name: Tapu Koko ◇
flavorText: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

name: Zeraora
flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidorina
flavorText: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

name: Nidoqueen
flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

name: Nidorino
flavorText: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

name: Nidoking
flavorText: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.

name: Tentacool
flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

name: Tentacruel
flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

name: Grimer
flavorText: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can't multiply, and it dies.

name: Muk
flavorText: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavorText: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

name: Starmie
flavorText: Its sparkling core is called "the gem of the sea." This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

name: Jynx
flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

name: Cosmog
flavorText: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

name: Cosmoem
flavorText: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

name: Mankey
flavorText: The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn't hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.

name: Primeape
flavorText: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can't move, it never ever forgives.

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

name: Omanyte
flavorText: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.

name: Omastar
flavorText: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It's apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.

name: Kabuto
flavorText: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It's said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.

name: Kabutops
flavorText: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn't adapt in time and went extinct.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Pancham
flavorText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavorText: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

name: Alolan Muk
flavorText: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

name: Tyranitar
flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

name: Poochyena
flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Absol
flavorText: Although it's said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago

name: Zorua
flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it's still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.

name: Pangoro
flavorText: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Its metal body is sturdy, but it does rust rather easily. So on rainy days, this Pokémon prefers to stay put in its nest.

name: Jirachi
flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

name: Ferrothorn
flavorText: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Honedge
