flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Doublade
flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

name: Klefki
flavorText: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavorText: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavorText: Exeggutor is the pride of the Alolan people. Its image is carved into historical buildings and murals.

name: Dratini
flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

name: Dratini
flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

name: Dragonite
flavorText: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

name: Pidgey
flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgey
flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
flavorText: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Meowth
flavorText: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

name: Persian
flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

name: Farfetch'd
flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

name: Tauros
flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

name: Aerodactyl
flavorText: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.

name: Lugia
flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Zangoose
flavorText: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

name: Scyther
flavorText: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Dartrix
flavorText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

name: Wimpod
flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Pheromosa
flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

name: Charmander
flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Wooper
flavorText: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

name: Quagsire
flavorText: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Xurkitree
flavorText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

name: Seviper
flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

name: Inkay
flavorText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

name: Malamar
flavorText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

name: Poipole
flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

name: Lucario
flavorText: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

name: Buzzwole
flavorText: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

name: Zorua
flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

name: Guzzlord
flavorText: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

name: Magneton
flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Beldum
flavorText: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Metang
flavorText: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

name: Celesteela
flavorText: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

name: Kartana
flavorText: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

name: Ralts
flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Diancie
flavorText: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Altaria
flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Gible
flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

name: Swablu
flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Noibat
flavorText: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: Oranguru
flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

name: Type: Null
flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Litten
flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Popplio
flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

name: Pikipek

name: Litten
flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

name: Shiinotic
flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

name: Bruxish
flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

name: Passimian
flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

name: Oranguru
flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

name: Alolan Sandslash

name: Oricorio

name: Mudsdale

name: Drampa
flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Rowlet

name: Popplio

name: Lurantis

name: Tsareena

name: Turtonator
flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: Vikavolt
flavorText: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

name: Mimikyu

name: Zygarde

name: Golisopod

name: Lucario
flavorText: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

name: Decidueye

name: Tapu Bulu

name: Silvally

name: Alolan Raichu
flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

name: Shining Ho-Oh

name: Alolan Raichu

name: Registeel

name: Pikachu

flavorText: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Tapu Fini

name: Gumshoos

name: Ash's Pikachu
flavorText: This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer's cap. Since the cap's not the right size, the fit is a bit loose.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavorText: Possessing a calm demeanor, this Pokémon was revered as a deity incarnate before it was identified as a regional variant of Ninetales.

name: Kyogre
flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Celesteela
flavorText: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

name: Delcatty
flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Latias
flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

name: Latios
flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Salamence
flavorText: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up the fields it passes over.

name: Kyurem
flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Moltres
flavorText: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

name: Suicune
flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Raikou
flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

name: Giratina
flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Tapu Lele
flavorText: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Salandit
flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feel stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

name: Charizard
flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Nidoqueen
flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

name: Jirachi
flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: A lonely Pokémon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Ultra Necrozma
flavorText: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

name: Detective Pikachu
flavorText: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

name: Meltan
flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Volcanion
flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Stakataka
flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Melmetal
flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Persian
flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

name: Typhlosion
flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: Flareon
flavorText: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

name: Detective Pikachu
flavorText: He was the partner of Tim's father, Harry, who has gone missing. This Pikachu loves the dark coffee at the Hi-Hat Cafe.

name: Detective Pikachu
flavorText: Skilled in deduction, he's a self-proclaimed "great detective." His detective hat is his trademark.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

name: Amoonguss
flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

name: Tapu Fini
flavorText: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Necrozma
flavorText: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: It's so popular with the elderly that there's a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.

name: Vikavolt
flavorText: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

name: Stakataka
flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

name: Mew
flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Buzzwole
flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Entei
flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Phione
flavorText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

name: Blacephalon
flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Celebi
flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Charizard
flavorText: This Pokémon was created by Mewtwo to prove that copies can be even more powerful than their originals.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Armored Mewtwo
flavorText: Mewtwo was on a rampage searching for meaning to its existence in this world when Giovanni suppressed and controlled its power.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

name: Eevee
flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: Although it doesn't like disputes, it will sharpen the leaf on its tail into a blade and fight if it has to protect its friends.

name: Glaceon
flavorText: It protects itself by freezing its fur into sharp needles. It can drop its body temperature below –75 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Regigigas
flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Aipom
flavorText: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

name: Heracross
flavorText: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Breloom
flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Cacnea
flavorText: It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Cacturne
flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

name: Tropius
flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Scatterbug
flavorText: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.

name: Spewpa
flavorText: Spewpa doesn't live in a fixed location. It roams where it pleases across the fields and mountains, building up the energy it needs to evolve.

name: Vivillon
flavorText: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

name: Skiddo
flavorText: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the back of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

name: Gogoat
flavorText: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

name: Sprigatito
flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floragato
flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Meowscarada
flavorText: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Tarountula
flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

name: Tarountula
flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Tarountula
flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Spidops ex
flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Smoliv
flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Smoliv

name: Dolliv
flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Toedscool
flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscool
flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscruel
flavorText: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

name: Capsakid
flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

name: Capsakid
flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

name: Scovillain
flavorText: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Growlithe

name: Arcanine ex
flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Houndour
flavorText: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Fuecoco
flavorText: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

name: Crocalor
flavorText: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

name: Skeledirge
flavorText: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Charcadet
flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Charcadet
flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Armarouge
flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados ex
flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Alomomola
flavorText: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

name: Clauncher
flavorText: Clauncher's claws will regrow if they fall off. The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a distinct flavor that doesn't appeal to all tastes.

name: Clawitzer
flavorText: The cannonballs of seawater that Clawitzer launches from its claw are powerful enough to punch through tanker hulls.

name: Bruxish
flavorText: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

name: Quaxly
flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

name: Quaxwell
flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

name: Quaquaval
flavorText: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

name: Wiglett
flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wiglett
flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wugtrio
flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Cetoddle
flavorText: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetoddle
flavorText: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetitan
flavorText: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Dondozo
flavorText: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

name: Tatsugiri
flavorText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges electromagnetic waves and so on from the units at its sides.

name: Magneton
flavorText: They're formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

name: Magnezone ex
flavorText: They're formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Toxel
flavorText: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

name: Pawmi
flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmi

name: Pawmo
flavorText: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

name: Pawmot
flavorText: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Wattrel
flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Wattrel

name: Kilowattrel
flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Miraidon
flavorText: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

name: Miraidon ex
flavorText: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

name: Hypno
flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Ralts
flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir ex
flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.

name: Banette ex
flavorText: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

name: Flabébé
flavorText: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.

name: Floette
flavorText: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

name: Florges
flavorText: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

name: Klefki
flavorText: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

name: Fidough
flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

name: Fidough
flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

name: Dachsbun
flavorText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: Flittle
flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

name: Flittle
flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

name: Flittle

name: Espathra
flavorText: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

name: Greavard
flavorText: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Greavard
flavorText: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Houndstone
flavorText: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

name: Mankey
flavorText: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

name: Primeape
flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

name: Annihilape
flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

name: Meditite
flavorText: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

name: Medicham
flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Riolu
flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Riolu
flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Sandile
flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

name: Silicobra
flavorText: Silicobra's neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time Silicobra sheds its skin.

name: Sandaconda
flavorText: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

name: Stonjourner
flavorText: The elemental composition of the rocks that form its body were found to match the bedrock of a land far away from this Pokémon's habitat.

name: Klawf
flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: Great Tusk ex
flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: Koraidon
flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

name: Koraidon ex

name: Grimer
flavorText: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

name: Muk
flavorText: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Seviper
flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

name: Kingambit
flavorText: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

name: Maschiff
flavorText: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Maschiff

name: Mabosstiff
flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Bombirdier
flavorText: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Forretress
flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Varoom
flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Varoom

name: Revavroom
flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

name: Blissey
flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

name: Zangoose
flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

name: Zangoose
flavorText: It's Seviper's archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

name: Starly
flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

name: Staraptor
flavorText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Skwovet
flavorText: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

name: Greedent
flavorText: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Indeedee
flavorText: In search of happy feelings—such as joy and gratitude—Indeedee bustles around, taking diligent care of people and other Pokémon.

name: Lechonk
flavorText: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

flavorText: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.

name: Skiploom
flavorText: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon's head.

name: Jumpluff
flavorText: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

name: Heracross
flavorText: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

name: Tropius
flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Combee
flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Vespiquen
flavorText: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

name: Snover
flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

name: Sprigatito
flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Sprigatito
flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floragato
flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Tarountula
flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

name: Tarountula
flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

name: Spidops
flavorText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

name: Nymble
flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Nymble
flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Lokix
flavorText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Bramblin
flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Bramblin
flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Brambleghast
flavorText: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Rellor
flavorText: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

name: Rellor
flavorText: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavorText: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs.

name: Litleo
flavorText: When Litleo are young, female Pyroar will teach them how to hunt. Once the Litleo mature, they will leave the pride and set out on their own.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride doesn't starve.

name: Oricorio
flavorText: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

name: Fuecoco
flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Fuecoco
flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Crocalor
flavorText: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

name: Charcadet
flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Charcadet
flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavorText: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Marill
flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill
flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

name: Luvdisc
flavorText: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

name: Eiscue
flavorText: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

name: Quaxly
flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

name: Quaxly
flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

name: Quaxwell
flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

name: Cetoddle
flavorText: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

name: Cetoddle
flavorText: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

name: Cetitan
flavorText: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

name: Veluza
flavorText: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

name: Frigibax
flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

name: Frigibax
flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

name: Arctibax
flavorText: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

name: Baxcalibur
flavorText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavorText: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Shinx
flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Shinx
flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

name: Pincurchin
flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

name: Pincurchin
flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

name: Pawmi
flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavorText: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot
flavorText: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Tadbulb
flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Tadbulb
flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Wattrel
flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Wattrel
flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Kilowattrel
flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Gothita
flavorText: This Pokémon is normally very innocent. When it is staring at something invisible, it is unblinking and utterly silent.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: Gothitelle unleashes psychic energy and shows opponents dreams of the universe's end. These dreams are apparently ethereal and beautiful.

name: Oranguru
flavorText: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

name: Sandygast
flavorText: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else— like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Palossand
flavorText: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Ceruledge
flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Rabsca
flavorText: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

name: Tinkatink
flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Tinkatink
flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Tinkatink
flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Tinkatuff
flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: Tinkatuff
flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: Tinkaton
flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

name: Mankey
flavorText: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Primeape
flavorText: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavorText: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Passimian
flavorText: This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries. It won't obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls without skill.

name: Falinks
flavorText: The brass, which is the one that stands at the front and issues orders, is the strongest and smartest of the six.

name: Nacli
flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Nacli
flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Naclstack
flavorText: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

name: Garganacl
flavorText: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Glimmet
flavorText: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

name: Glimmet
flavorText: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

name: Glimmora
flavorText: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Weavile
flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Tyranitar
flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Seviper
flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Deino
flavorText: It can't see, so its first approach to examining things is to bite them. You will be covered in wounds until a Deino warms up to you.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: The two heads do not get along at all. If you don't give each head the same amount of attention, they'll begin fighting out of jealousy.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: Only the central head has a brain. It is very intelligent, but it thinks only of destruction.

name: Maschiff
flavorText: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

name: Maschiff
flavorText: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

name: Mabosstiff
flavorText: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

name: Shroodle
flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: Shroodle
flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: Grafaiai
flavorText: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

name: Bombirdier
flavorText: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon's chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

name: Corviknight
flavorText: Corviknight can't serve as a taxi service in Paldea because the Pokémon's natural predators will attack it while it flies, endangering the customer.

name: Cufant
flavorText: Using the pointy tip of its trunk, it carves off chunks of hard rocks to eat. It is very docile and helps people with physical labor.

name: Orthworm
flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

name: Noibat
flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

name: Girafarig
flavorText: Though very small, the brain in its tail is still considered an important organ because it emits powerful psychic energy.

name: Farigiraf
flavorText: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

name: Dudunsparce
flavorText: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

name: Wingull
flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

name: Pelipper
flavorText: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

name: Vigoroth
flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

name: Slaking
flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

name: Rookidee
flavorText: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

name: Corvisquire
flavorText: It's said that the reason behind Corvisquire's high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

name: Tandemaus
flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

name: Tandemaus
flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

name: Maushold
flavorText: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

name: Flamigo
flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Oddish
flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Bellossom
flavorText: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Scyther
flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Surskit
flavorText: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

name: Masquerain
flavorText: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

name: Combee
flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Foongus
flavorText: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

name: Amoonguss
flavorText: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss's caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

name: Phantump
flavorText: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
flavorText: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

name: Dartrix
flavorText: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

name: Bounsweet
flavorText: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavorText: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
flavorText: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Smoliv
flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Dolliv
flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Capsakid
flavorText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Capsakid
flavorText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Scovillain
flavorText: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

name: Charmander
flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Entei
flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Numel
flavorText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

name: Camerupt
flavorText: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Litwick
flavorText: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Lampent
flavorText: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—or so it's said.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

name: Charcadet
flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Armarouge
flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Lapras
flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Tympole
flavorText: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Seismitoad
flavorText: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: Many of this species can be found along the shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks dangling snot, there's a chance it is sick.

name: Beartic
flavorText: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

name: Cryogonal
flavorText: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 600 metres in a minute's time.

name: Wiglett
flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wugtrio
flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Finizen
flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Finizen
flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Palafin
flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavorText: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross
flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Thundurus
flavorText: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

name: Toxel
flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

name: Tadbulb
flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Tadbulb
flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Tadbulb
flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Bellibolt
flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: Bellibolt
flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: Cleffa
flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

name: Togepi
flavorText: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.

name: Togetic
flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: Togekiss
flavorText: Known as a bringer of blessings, it's been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

name: Espeon
flavorText: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
flavorText: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Mawile
flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Spoink
flavorText: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

name: Grumpig
flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Solrock
flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Claydol
flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Sinistea
flavorText: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

name: Polteageist
flavorText: The tea that composes Polteageist's body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much, however, can be fatal.

name: Greavard
flavorText: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

name: Greavard
flavorText: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

name: Houndstone
flavorText: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

name: Diglett
flavorText: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

name: Nosepass
