name: Swinub
flavorText: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

name: Piloswine
flavorText: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Mamoswine
flavorText: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

name: Mantine
flavorText: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

name: Barboach
flavorText: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

name: Whiscash
flavorText: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

name: Regice
flavorText: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

name: Glaceon
flavorText: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name "scalchop.".

name: Dewott
flavorText: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Hisuian Basculin
flavorText: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Hisuian Basculegion
flavorText: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Radiant Greninja
flavorText: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Bergmite
flavorText: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Hisuian Avalugg
flavorText: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Regieleki
flavorText: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

name: Hisuian Typhlosion
flavorText: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Togepi
flavorText: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

name: Togetic
flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss
flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

name: Ralts
flavorText: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gallade
flavorText: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

name: Uxie
flavorText: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

name: Mesprit
flavorText: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

name: Azelf
flavorText: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.

name: Diancie
flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Wyrdeer
flavorText: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Hisuian Growlithe
flavorText: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Hisuian Arcanine
flavorText: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

name: Regirock
flavorText: Every bit of Regirock's body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what's been lost.

name: Cranidos
flavorText: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.

name: Rampardos
flavorText: This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

name: Radiant Hawlucha
flavorText: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Hisuian Decidueye
flavorText: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

name: Kleavor
flavorText: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Kleavor
flavorText: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Hisuian Qwilfish
flavorText: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Hisuian Qwilfish
flavorText: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Hisuian Overqwil
flavorText: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Hisuian Overqwil
flavorText: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Hisuian Sneasel
flavorText: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

name: Hisuian Sneasler
flavorText: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Poochyena
flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Absol
flavorText: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Hisuian Samurott
flavorText: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Nickit
flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

name: Magneton
flavorText: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

name: Registeel
flavorText: Registeel's body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

name: Shieldon
flavorText: Although its fossils can be found in layers of primeval rock, nothing but its face has ever been discovered.

name: Bastiodon
flavorText: This Pokémon is from roughly 100 million years ago. Its terrifyingly tough face is harder than steel.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

name: Regidrago
flavorText: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

name: Eevee
flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Hoothoot
flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl
flavorText: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

name: Ursaring
flavorText: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

name: Ursaluna
flavorText: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Stantler
flavorText: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Miltank
flavorText: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

name: Glameow
flavorText: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

name: Purugly
flavorText: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

name: Chatot
flavorText: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

name: Regigigas
flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Hisuian Braviary
flavorText: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: The Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

name: Flapple
flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Kingdra
flavorText: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

name: Frosmoth
flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Wyrdeer
flavorText: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Falinks
flavorText: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Kleavor
flavorText: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

name: Hoothoot
flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Oddish
flavorText: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavorText: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Paras
flavorText: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Parasect
flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

name: Wurmple
flavorText: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Silcoon
flavorText: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

name: Beautifly
flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

name: Cascoon
flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Dustox
flavorText: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

name: Seedot
flavorText: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: Roselia
flavorText: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

name: Roserade
flavorText: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

name: Phantump
flavorText: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Trevenant
flavorText: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

name: Blipbug
flavorText: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

name: Dottler
flavorText: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

name: Orbeetle
flavorText: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: Slugma
flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Litwick
flavorText: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

name: Lampent
flavorText: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

name: Litleo
flavorText: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavorText: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Politoed
flavorText: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

name: Seel
flavorText: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

name: Horsea
flavorText: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra
flavorText: It's the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

name: Kingdra
flavorText: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.

name: Luvdisc
flavorText: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

name: Shellos
flavorText: There's speculation that its appearance is determined by what it eats, but the truth remains elusive.

name: Finneon
flavorText: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.

name: Lumineon
flavorText: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.

name: Snover
flavorText: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

name: Hisuian Basculin
flavorText: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Hisuian Basculegion
flavorText: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Cramorant
flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Glastrier
flavorText: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Electrike
flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

name: Clefable
flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

name: Haunter
flavorText: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

name: Gengar
flavorText: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

name: Jynx
flavorText: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Radiant Gardevoir
flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Sableye
flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

name: Mawile
flavorText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

name: Banette
flavorText: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Hisuian Zorua
flavorText: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Hisuian Zoroark
flavorText: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Inkay
flavorText: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Malamar
flavorText: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

name: Comfey
flavorText: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

name: Spectrier
flavorText: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Hisuian Growlithe
flavorText: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Hisuian Arcanine
flavorText: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Poliwrath
flavorText: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

name: Machop
flavorText: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavorText: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

name: Machamp
flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

name: Rhydon
flavorText: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

name: Rhyperior
flavorText: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

name: Meditite
flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Medicham
flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Gastrodon
flavorText: Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land, where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it passes through.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

name: Mienshao
flavorText: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

name: Landorus
flavorText: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Binacle
flavorText: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

name: Barbaracle
flavorText: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Carbink
flavorText: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all out by firing high-energy beams from the gems embedded in its body.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

name: Falinks
flavorText: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Stonjourner
flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavorText: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

name: Seviper
flavorText: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It's Zangoose's archrival.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

name: Inkay
flavorText: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Hoopa
flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Radiant Hisuian Sneasler
flavorText: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Radiant Steelix
flavorText: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
flavorText: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

name: Magearna
flavorText: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Goomy
flavorText: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Hisuian Sliggoo
flavorText: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Hisuian Goodra
flavorText: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.

name: Porygon
flavorText: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2
flavorText: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z's behavior.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Aipom
flavorText: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

name: Bouffalant
flavorText: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

name: Komala
flavorText: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

name: Skwovet
flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Parasect
flavorText: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

name: Roserade
flavorText: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

name: Charizard
flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

name: Gengar
flavorText: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

name: Banette
flavorText: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Hisuian Arcanine
flavorText: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

name: Castform
flavorText: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

name: Boss's Orders
flavorText: Lysandre

name: Venonat
flavorText: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Venomoth
flavorText: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavorText: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Sunkern
flavorText: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

name: Sunflora
flavorText: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

name: Petilil
flavorText: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Hisuian Lilligant
flavorText: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Foongus
flavorText: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

name: Amoonguss
flavorText: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

name: Durant
flavorText: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

name: Virizion
flavorText: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

name: Radiant Tsareena
flavorText: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

name: Rapidash
flavorText: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Victini
flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

name: Litten
flavorText: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

name: Torracat
flavorText: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

name: Incineroar
flavorText: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.

name: Articuno
flavorText: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Wailord
flavorText: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Feebas
flavorText: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

name: Milotic
flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: It's said that if they are seen at midnight, they'll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

name: Glalie
flavorText: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

name: Froslass
flavorText: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Phione
flavorText: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Dewpider
flavorText: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

name: Araquanid
flavorText: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

name: Rotom
flavorText: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

name: Emolga
flavorText: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

name: Zeraora
flavorText: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Radiant Alakazam
flavorText: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

name: Hypno
flavorText: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

name: Jynx
flavorText: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: What makes it happy is imitating the voices of weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn't deal well with folks who aren't easily frightened.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

name: Ralts
flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Meditite
flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Medicham
flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Chimecho
flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

name: Solosis
flavorText: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

name: Duosion
flavorText: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

name: Reuniclus
flavorText: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

name: Elgyem
flavorText: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

name: Beheeyem
flavorText: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

name: Espurr
flavorText: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

name: Swirlix
flavorText: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: A Dedenne's whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

name: Indeedee
flavorText: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

name: Dreepy
flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Drakloak
flavorText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Dragapult
flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Donphan
flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Anorith
flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

name: Armaldo
flavorText: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Sandygast
flavorText: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

name: Palossand
flavorText: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

name: Stonjourner
flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Zubat
flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat
flavorText: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

name: Crobat
flavorText: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

name: Sandile
flavorText: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

name: Mareanie
flavorText: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

name: Toxapex
flavorText: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

name: Morpeko
flavorText: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

name: Beldum
flavorText: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.

name: Metang
flavorText: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

name: Metagross
flavorText: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

name: Radiant Jirachi
flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
flavorText: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Klink
flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region's Pokémon.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Dratini
flavorText: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.

name: Dragonite
flavorText: It's a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.

name: Noibat
flavorText: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

name: Noivern
flavorText: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: Born when around 10% of Zygarde's cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Spinda
flavorText: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!

name: Swablu
flavorText: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.

name: Altaria
flavorText: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

name: Buneary
flavorText: If both of Buneary's ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It's a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

name: Archen
flavorText: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.

name: Archeops
flavorText: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Hisuian Braviary
flavorText: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

name: Oddish
flavorText: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavorText: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Bellossom
flavorText: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

name: Scyther
flavorText: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.

name: Sunkern
flavorText: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

name: Yanma
flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Kricketot
flavorText: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Grubbin
flavorText: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Zarude
flavorText: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

name: Calyrex
flavorText: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

name: Radiant Charizard
flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Entei
flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it's trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.

name: Volcanion
flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Salandit
flavorText: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

name: Seel
flavorText: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavorText: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Wailord
flavorText: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Corphish
flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Luvdisc
flavorText: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

name: Kyogre
flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Shinx
flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxio
flavorText: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

name: Emolga
flavorText: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

name: Radiant Charjabug
flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Zeraora
flavorText: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Pincurchin
flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

name: Girafarig
flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Dusclops
flavorText: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Tapu Lele
flavorText: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

name: Enamorus
flavorText: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Graveler
flavorText: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

name: Solrock
flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Pancham
flavorText: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

name: Lycanroc
flavorText: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.

name: Koffing
flavorText: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

name: Absol
flavorText: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

name: Pangoro
flavorText: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

name: Skrelp
flavorText: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

name: Dragalge
flavorText: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

name: Hoopa
flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Scizor
flavorText: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

name: Aron
flavorText: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
flavorText: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

name: Aggron
flavorText: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

name: Metang
flavorText: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

name: Zacian
flavorText: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

name: Zamazenta
flavorText: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

name: Radiant Eternatus
flavorText: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: Tauros
flavorText: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it's a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

name: Ditto
flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

name: Starly
flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Chatot
flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Yungoos
flavorText: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Gumshoos
flavorText: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Oranguru
flavorText: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.

name: Wooloo
flavorText: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

name: Dubwool
flavorText: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

name: Professor's Research
flavorText: Professor Rowan

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Hisuian Voltorb
flavorText: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

name: Kricketune
flavorText: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Oricorio
flavorText: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Lapras
flavorText: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Electivire
flavorText: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

name: Mew
flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Deoxys
subtype: Basic, Fusion Strike, Single Strike, Rapid Strike
flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Diancie
flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Comfey
flavorText: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

name: Solrock
flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Absol
flavorText: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Thievul
flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

name: Altaria
flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Latias
flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

name: Hisuian Goodra
flavorText: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy— it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Ditto
flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

name: Miltank
flavorText: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

name: Bibarel
flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Swablu
flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Duskull
flavorText: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Paras
flavorText: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Poochyena
flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

name: Braixen
flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Milotic
flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Jynx
flavorText: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Malamar
flavorText: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Passimian
flavorText: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Altaria
flavorText: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Metapod
flavorText: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Scyther
flavorText: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Heracross
flavorText: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.

name: Lotad
flavorText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

name: Lombre
flavorText: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

name: Ludicolo
flavorText: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

name: Surskit
flavorText: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

name: Masquerain
flavorText: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

name: Snover
flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

name: Phantump
flavorText: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Trevenant
flavorText: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

name: Grubbin
flavorText: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

name: Applin
flavorText: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Applin
flavorText: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Flapple
flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Appletun
flavorText: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Growlithe
