flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

name: Magmortar
flavorText: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.

name: Litwick
flavorText: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

name: Lampent
flavorText: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavorText: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Wingull
flavorText: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

name: Pelipper
flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

name: Tympole
flavorText: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

name: Seismitoad
flavorText: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

name: Galarian Darumaka
flavorText: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavorText: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

name: Cramorant
flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Arrokuda
flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

name: Barraskewda
flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Eiscue
flavorText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

name: Electivire
flavorText: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

name: Charjabug
flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
flavorText: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Toxel
flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: Morpeko
flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Natu
flavorText: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

name: Xatu
flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Galarian Corsola
flavorText: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

name: Galarian Cursola
flavorText: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

name: Sandygast
flavorText: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

name: Palossand
flavorText: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

name: Hatenna
flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hattrem
flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hatterene
flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Milcery
flavorText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: Indeedee
flavorText: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

name: Dreepy
flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Drakloak
flavorText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Dragapult
flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Galarian Farfetch'd
flavorText: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: Nosepass
flavorText: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

name: Meditite
flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Medicham
flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Barboach
flavorText: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

name: Whiscash
flavorText: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

name: Galarian Yamask
flavorText: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

name: Galarian Runerigus
flavorText: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

name: Binacle
flavorText: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

name: Barbaracle
flavorText: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Rolycoly
flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Carkol
flavorText: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Coalossal
flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Falinks
flavorText: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Stonjourner
flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Galarian Weezing
flavorText: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

name: Stunky
flavorText: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.

name: Skuntank
flavorText: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon's diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: Although it's a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they're ready to leave the nest.

name: Impidimp
flavorText: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Morgrem
flavorText: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavorText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Scizor
flavorText: Once it has identified something as an enemy, it will continue beating them with its steel-hard pincers until there's nothing left but scraps.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

name: Probopass
flavorText: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

name: Durant
flavorText: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

name: Honedge
flavorText: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.

name: Doublade
flavorText: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

name: Duraludon
flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Zacian
flavorText: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

name: Zamazenta
flavorText: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Chatot
flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Pidove
flavorText: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful—several hundred of them can gather at once.

name: Tranquill
flavorText: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

name: Unfezant
flavorText: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Diggersby
flavorText: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Stufful
flavorText: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
flavorText: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Skwovet
flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Frosmoth
flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Paras
flavorText: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Parasect
flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Pansage
flavorText: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Simisage
flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Karrablast
flavorText: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Shelmet
flavorText: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

name: Accelgor
flavorText: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Dartrix
flavorText: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

name: Decidueye
flavorText: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

name: Bounsweet
flavorText: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

name: Steenee
flavorText: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

name: Tsareena
flavorText: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

name: Wimpod
flavorText: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavorText: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Torchic
flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Combusken
flavorText: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Blaziken
flavorText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

name: Heatran
flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Pansear
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Simisear
flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavorText: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavorText: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Suicune
flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Feebas
flavorText: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

name: Milotic
flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: The reason it hasn't changed at all in a hundred million years is that it's apparently already a perfect life-form.

name: Panpour
flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
flavorText: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Galarian Darumaka
flavorText: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavorText: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

name: Vanillish
flavorText: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

name: Vanilluxe
flavorText: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

name: Beartic
flavorText: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

name: Wishiwashi
flavorText: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

name: Mareanie
flavorText: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

name: Toxapex
flavorText: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

name: Dracovish
flavorText: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

name: Arctovish
flavorText: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Electrike
flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

name: Tapu Koko
flavorText: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

name: Toxel
flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

name: Pincurchin
flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Dracozolt
flavorText: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

name: Arctozolt
flavorText: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

name: Snubbull
flavorText: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
flavorText: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

name: Golett
flavorText: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

name: Golurk
flavorText: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

name: Morelull
flavorText: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Shiinotic
flavorText: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

name: Sinistea
flavorText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Polteageist
flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Diglett
flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

name: Tyranitar
flavorText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Flygon
flavorText: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

name: Solrock
flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

name: Diggersby
flavorText: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

name: Passimian
flavorText: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: Grimer
flavorText: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

name: Muk
flavorText: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavorText: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Deino
flavorText: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

name: Hoopa
flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Nickit
flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

name: Aron
flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Lairon
flavorText: It habitually shows off its strength with the sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

name: Aggron
flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

name: Escavalier
flavorText: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

name: Klink
flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Meltan
flavorText: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
flavorText: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

name: Cufant
flavorText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Copperajah
flavorText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

name: Tauros
flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

name: Sentret
flavorText: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

name: Furret
flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Ursaring
flavorText: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

name: Lugia
flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Starly
flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
flavorText: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

name: Staraptor
flavorText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

name: Skwovet
flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Rookidee
flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Corvisquire
flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Corviknight
flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Rillaboom
flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Coalossal
flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Victini
flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Sizzlipede
flavorText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch
flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

name: Hatenna
flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hattrem
flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hatterene
flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Machop
flavorText: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Lycanroc
flavorText: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

name: Rolycoly
flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Ekans
flavorText: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

name: Arbok
flavorText: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavorText: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavorText: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Absol
flavorText: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: As halfhearted as this Pokémon's kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr's concrete pillars.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Inkay
flavorText: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Malamar
flavorText: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

name: Nickit
flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Swablu
flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Altaria
flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.

name: Yanma
flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

name: Celebi
flavorText: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

name: Seedot
flavorText: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: Nincada
flavorText: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

name: Ninjask
flavorText: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Skiddo
flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Dhelmise
flavorText: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Charmander
flavorText: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Flareon
flavorText: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Slugma
flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Wailord
flavorText: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott
flavorText: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

name: Samurott
flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Chewtle
flavorText: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

name: Drednaw
flavorText: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: Cramorant
flavorText: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

name: Arrokuda
flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

name: Barraskewda
flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Raikou
flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

name: Electrike
flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Joltik
flavorText: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Zeraora
flavorText: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

name: Pincurchin
flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Girafarig
flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

name: Shedinja
flavorText: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

name: Banette
flavorText: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Duskull
flavorText: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

name: Dusclops
flavorText: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

name: Chimecho
flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Woobat
flavorText: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

name: Swoobat
flavorText: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Whimsicott
flavorText: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

name: Xerneas
flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Diancie
flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Milcery
flavorText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: Zacian
flavorText: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

name: Wooper
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
flavorText: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Donphan
flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Regirock
flavorText: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: Born when all of Zygarde's cells have been gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those who harm the ecosystem.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Lycanroc
flavorText: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

name: Mudbray
flavorText: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

name: Mudsdale
flavorText: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

name: Clobbopus
flavorText: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Grapploct
flavorText: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Zamazenta
flavorText: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

name: Poochyena
flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Sableye
flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

name: Sandile
flavorText: Sandile's still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It's called "the cleaner of the desert."

name: Krokorok
flavorText: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Forretress
flavorText: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

name: Beldum
flavorText: If you anger it, it will do more than rampage. It will also burst out strong magnetism, causing nearby machines to break.

name: Metang
flavorText: It flies at high speeds around the skies. When it finds its prey, Metang takes a firm grip with its sharp claws and never lets go.

name: Metagross
flavorText: It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.

name: Jirachi
flavorText: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near-perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Excadrill
flavorText: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
flavorText: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
flavorText: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

name: Magearna
flavorText: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Duraludon
flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Eevee
flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Lugia
flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Taillow
flavorText: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Swellow
flavorText: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

name: Whismur
flavorText: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

name: Loudred
flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Exploud
flavorText: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor—or like an earthquake has struck.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

name: Chatot
flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Tornadus
flavorText: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Pikipek
flavorText: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Trumbeak
flavorText: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Toucannon
flavorText: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Oranguru
flavorText: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Yanma
flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Celebi
flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

name: Cacnea
flavorText: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Tropius
flavorText: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Dartrix
flavorText: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

name: Decidueye
flavorText: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

name: Grookey
flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Thwackey
flavorText: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Rillaboom
flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Gossifleur
flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
flavorText: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Zarude
flavorText: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Horsea
flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

name: Kyogre
flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Volcanion
flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Chewtle
flavorText: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
flavorText: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Cramorant
flavorText: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

name: Snom
flavorText: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

name: Frosmoth
flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Rotom
flavorText: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

name: Morpeko
flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Morpeko
flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Galarian Weezing
flavorText: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Nickit
flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Cufant
flavorText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Eevee
flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Indeedee
flavorText: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Dartrix
flavorText: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

name: Decidueye
flavorText: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

name: Grookey
flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Thwackey
flavorText: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Rillaboom
flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Blipbug
flavorText: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Dottler
flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Gossifleur
flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
flavorText: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Applin
flavorText: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Flapple
flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Appletun
flavorText: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

name: Scorbunny
flavorText: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Raboot
flavorText: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Cinderace
flavorText: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Sizzlipede
flavorText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch
flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavorText: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Suicune
flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Galarian Darumaka
flavorText: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavorText: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

name: Sobble
flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Drizzile
flavorText: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: Inteleon
flavorText: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Chewtle
flavorText: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
flavorText: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Cramorant
flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Arrokuda
flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

name: Barraskewda
flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Snom
flavorText: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

name: Frosmoth
flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Eiscue
flavorText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: Dracovish
flavorText: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

name: Arctovish
flavorText: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: Rotom
flavorText: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

name: Yamper
flavorText: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

name: Boltund
flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Toxel
flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: Pincurchin
flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Morpeko
flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Dracozolt
flavorText: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

name: Arctozolt
flavorText: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: Galarian Ponyta
flavorText: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

name: Galarian Rapidash
flavorText: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

name: Galarian Corsola
flavorText: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

name: Galarian Cursola
flavorText: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

name: Sinistea
flavorText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Polteageist
flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Hatenna
flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hattrem
flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hatterene
flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Milcery
flavorText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: Indeedee
flavorText: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

name: Dreepy
flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Drakloak
flavorText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Dragapult
flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Galarian Farfetch'd
flavorText: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: Galarian Yamask
flavorText: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

name: Galarian Runerigus
flavorText: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

name: Rolycoly
flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Carkol
flavorText: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Coalossal
flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Silicobra
flavorText: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Sandaconda
flavorText: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Clobbopus
flavorText: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Grapploct
flavorText: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Falinks
flavorText: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Stonjourner
flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Galarian Weezing
flavorText: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavorText: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavorText: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Nickit
flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Impidimp
flavorText: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Morgrem
flavorText: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavorText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
flavorText: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

name: Corviknight
flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Cufant
flavorText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Copperajah
flavorText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: Duraludon
flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Minccino
flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
