flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Oranguru
flavorText: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Skwovet
flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Rookidee
flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Corvisquire
flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Wooloo
flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Dubwool
flavorText: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Bellsprout
flavorText: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Weepinbell
flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

name: Victreebel
flavorText: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

name: Cacnea
flavorText: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Cacturne
flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

name: Cherrim
flavorText: The faint scent that emanates from its full blossom entices bug Pokémon to it.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Durant
flavorText: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Scatterbug
flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
flavorText: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Vivillon
flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Fomantis
flavorText: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

name: Lurantis
flavorText: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

name: Tapu Bulu
flavorText: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Blipbug
flavorText: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Entei
flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

name: Pignite
flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Salandit
flavorText: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

name: Sizzlipede
flavorText: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Centiskorch
flavorText: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Horsea
flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

name: Seadra
flavorText: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Kingdra
flavorText: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavorText: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
flavorText: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

name: Octillery
flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Corphish
flavorText: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

name: Crawdaunt
flavorText: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

name: Frillish
flavorText: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Jellicent
flavorText: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Bruxish
flavorText: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

name: Electivire
flavorText: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Yamper
flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Galarian Slowpoke
flavorText: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

name: Spoink
flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

name: Grumpig
flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Claydol
flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Chimecho
flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Espurr
flavorText: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Dottler
flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Mankey
flavorText: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

name: Primeape
flavorText: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

name: Onix
flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Cubone
flavorText: It wears its mother's skull on its head, so no one knows what its bare face looks like. However, it's clear that it's always crying.

name: Marowak
flavorText: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

name: Timburr
flavorText: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

name: Gurdurr
flavorText: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there's skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

name: Conkeldurr
flavorText: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

name: Mienshao
flavorText: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you're in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!

name: Rolycoly
flavorText: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Carkol
flavorText: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Coalossal
flavorText: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Silicobra
flavorText: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Sandaconda
flavorText: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Falinks
flavorText: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Stonjourner
flavorText: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Zubat
flavorText: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

name: Golbat
flavorText: They can suck down over 10 ounces of blood in one go. They have been known to drink so much blood that they can no longer fly.

name: Crobat
flavorText: It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can't drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

name: Galarian Slowbro
flavorText: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

name: Houndour
flavorText: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Morpeko
flavorText: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

name: Steelix
flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Mawile
flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

name: Honedge
flavorText: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

name: Doublade
flavorText: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Spearow
flavorText: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

name: Fearow
flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Lickitung
flavorText: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it's really clean is…questionable.

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.

name: Glameow
flavorText: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

name: Purugly
flavorText: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

name: Bouffalant
flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

name: Drampa
flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Indeedee
flavorText: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Octillery
flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Ledyba
flavorText: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
flavorText: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

name: Heracross
flavorText: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.

name: Snover
flavorText: The berries that grow around its belly are like ice pops. Galarian Darumaka absolutely love these berries.

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

name: Deerling
flavorText: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

name: Bounsweet
flavorText: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

name: Steenee
flavorText: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

name: Tsareena
flavorText: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.

name: Grookey
flavorText: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Thwackey
flavorText: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.

name: Rillaboom
flavorText: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Zarude
flavorText: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Castform Sunny Form
flavorText: Castform changes to this form when it basks in bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin, it feels all dried out!

name: Larvesta
flavorText: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

name: Scorbunny
flavorText: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Raboot
flavorText: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Cinderace
flavorText: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Lapras
flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

name: Weavile
flavorText: With its claws, it leaves behind signs for its friends to find. The number of distinct signs is said to be over 500.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

name: Castform Rainy Form
flavorText: This is Castform's form when pelted by rain. In an experiment where it was placed in a shower, this Pokémon didn't change to this form.

name: Castform Snowy Form
flavorText: This is Castform's form when caught in a hailstorm. Its whole body is chilled, and its skin is partially frozen!

name: Snorunt
flavorText: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as −150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Froslass
flavorText: It spits out cold air of nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.

name: Spheal
flavorText: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

name: Sealeo
flavorText: Be it Spheal or a Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.

name: Walrein
flavorText: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

name: Tapu Fini
flavorText: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

name: Sobble
flavorText: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

name: Drizzile
flavorText: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

name: Inteleon
flavorText: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

name: Rapid Strike Urshifu
flavorText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Thundurus
flavorText: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

name: Galarian Slowpoke
flavorText: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

name: Gastly
flavorText: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

name: Haunter
flavorText: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

name: Gengar
flavorText: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

name: Ralts
flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

name: Banette
flavorText: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Golett
flavorText: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Golurk
flavorText: There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.

name: Swirlix
flavorText: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: Slurpuff's fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

name: Inkay
flavorText: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

name: Malamar
flavorText: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Hatenna
flavorText: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

name: Hattrem
flavorText: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

name: Hatterene
flavorText: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

name: Diglett
flavorText: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.

name: Galarian Farfetch'd
flavorText: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Farfetch'd that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
flavorText: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

name: Gallade
flavorText: Sharply attuned to others' wishes for help, this Pokémon seeks out those in need and aids them in battle.

name: Galarian Yamask
flavorText: It's said that this Pokémon was formed when an ancient clay tablet was drawn to a vengeful spirit.

name: Galarian Runerigus
flavorText: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

name: Crabrawler
flavorText: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

name: Crabominable
flavorText: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

name: Rockruff
flavorText: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Lycanroc
flavorText: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

name: Passimian
flavorText: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

name: Clobbopus
flavorText: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

name: Grapploct
flavorText: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Kubfu
flavorText: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

name: Koffing
flavorText: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

name: Weezing
flavorText: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

name: Galarian Weezing
flavorText: Long ago, during a time when droves of factories fouled the air with pollution, Weezing changed into this form for some reason.

name: Galarian Slowking
flavorText: While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon combines its internal toxins with what it's eaten, creating strange potions.

name: Qwilfish
flavorText: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

name: Seviper
flavorText: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It's Zangoose's archrival.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

name: Venipede
flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

name: Whirlipede
flavorText: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

name: Scolipede
flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

name: Single Strike Urshifu
flavorText: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Aron
flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Lairon
flavorText: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

name: Aggron
flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

name: Tauros
flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

name: Porygon
flavorText: It was built 20 years ago by scientists who dreamed of exploring space. Their dreams have yet to come true.

name: Porygon2
flavorText: Even though it doesn't die in the vacuum of space, it can't move around very well in zero gravity.

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: A faulty update was added to its programming. Its behavior is noticeably strange, so the experiment may have been a failure.

name: Zangoose
flavorText: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

name: Castform
flavorText: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

name: Kecleon
flavorText: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Furfrou
flavorText: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Skwovet
flavorText: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

name: Greedent
flavorText: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

name: Rapid Strike Scroll of the Skies
Electrode
flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Pinsir
flavorText: Although it's tough, it can't handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.

name: Hoppip
flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Skiploom
flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

name: Jumpluff
flavorText: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

name: Seedot
flavorText: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

name: Tropius
flavorText: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

name: Petilil
flavorText: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.

name: Lilligant
flavorText: It's well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.

name: Dwebble
flavorText: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Crustle
flavorText: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

name: Gossifleur
flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
flavorText: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Applin
flavorText: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

name: Entei
flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Victini
flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Litleo
flavorText: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: It has been found that its brain cells are 10 times more active when Psyduck is experiencing a headache.

name: Golduck
flavorText: A professional swimmer, it can continue swimming for two days straight by waving its long tail skillfully.

name: Tentacool
flavorText: Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison.

name: Tentacruel
flavorText: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it's a warning sign.

name: Lotad
flavorText: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

name: Lombre
flavorText: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Ludicolo
flavorText: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

name: Feebas
flavorText: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Milotic
flavorText: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.

name: Luvdisc
flavorText: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

name: Tympole
flavorText: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

name: Cryogonal
flavorText: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Bergmite
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold. It secures itself to the back of an Avalugg by freezing its feet in place.

name: Avalugg
flavorText: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon's body returns to a pristine state overnight.

name: Wishiwashi
flavorText: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

name: Eiscue
flavorText: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

name: Raichu
flavorText: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Emolga
flavorText: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

name: Regieleki
flavorText: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

name: Hypno
flavorText: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

name: Galarian Articuno
flavorText: Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that can immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid.

name: Wobbuffet
flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Woobat
flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

name: Swoobat
flavorText: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

name: Flabébé
flavorText: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

name: Floette
flavorText: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

name: Florges
flavorText: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavorText: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Gourgeist
flavorText: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Cutiefly
flavorText: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Ribombee
flavorText: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

name: Marshadow
flavorText: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Galarian Zapdos
flavorText: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: This Pokémon is active during the day and passes the cold desert nights burrowed snugly into the sand.

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out the quantities of sand it has swallowed and whips up a sandstorm.

name: Roggenrola
flavorText: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
flavorText: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.

name: Gigalith
flavorText: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Seismitoad
flavorText: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Galarian Moltres
flavorText: The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire around this Pokémon is what inspired the name Moltres.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

name: Zorua
flavorText: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

name: Nickit
flavorText: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Thievul
flavorText: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

name: Altaria
flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Bagon
flavorText: Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.

name: Shelgon
flavorText: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.

name: Salamence
flavorText: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart's desire—wings.

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Deino
flavorText: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.

name: Kyurem
flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Drampa
flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Flapple
flavorText: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Appletun
flavorText: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Regidrago
flavorText: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Ursaring
flavorText: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

name: Vigoroth
flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

name: Slaking
flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Swablu
flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it's intelligent, obedient to its Trainer's commands, and easy to raise.

name: Herdier
flavorText: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: A combative Pokémon, it's ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.

name: Braviary
flavorText: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

name: Rapid Strike Scroll of the Flying Dragon
Single Strike Scroll of the Fanged Dragon
Froslass
flavorText: It spits out cold air of nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.

name: Inteleon
flavorText: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
flavorText: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

name: Breloom
flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Pansage
flavorText: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Simisage
flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Maractus
flavorText: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

name: Shelmet
flavorText: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

name: Accelgor
flavorText: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Virizion
flavorText: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

name: Phantump
flavorText: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
flavorText: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Grubbin
flavorText: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Dewpider
flavorText: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

name: Araquanid
flavorText: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

name: Gossifleur
flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
flavorText: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Zarude
flavorText: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

name: Slugma
flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Victini
flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Pansear
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Simisear
flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Oricorio
flavorText: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Sizzlipede
flavorText: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Sizzlipede
flavorText: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Centiskorch
flavorText: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Centiskorch
flavorText: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Shellder
flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster
flavorText: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

name: Staryu
flavorText: No number of injuries can bother Staryu. Its amazing regenerative powers return it to its previous state in half a day!

name: Starmie
flavorText: It rotates its geometrically shaped body to swim through the water. It always seems to be sending out mysterious radio waves.

name: Lapras
flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Totodile
flavorText: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

name: Croconaw
flavorText: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

name: Feraligatr
flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: Marill
flavorText: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That's why this Pokémon is never cold.

name: Azumarill
flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

name: Qwilfish
flavorText: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

name: Mantine
flavorText: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.

name: Mudkip
flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Marshtomp
flavorText: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

name: Swampert
flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

name: Clamperl
flavorText: Clamperl's pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder's pearls.

name: Huntail
flavorText: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

name: Gorebyss
flavorText: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

name: Panpour
flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
flavorText: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Basculin
flavorText: Known for their violence, these Pokémon have the most fights with schools of red-striped Basculin.

name: Galarian Darumaka
flavorText: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavorText: Though it has a gentle disposition, it's also very strong. It will quickly freeze the snowball on its head before going for a headbutt.

name: Clauncher
flavorText: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it's terrible at swimming straight.

name: Clawitzer
flavorText: Its right arm is packed with meat. When its pincer falls off, it's exported to be used as a cooking ingredient.

name: Pyukumuku
flavorText: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

name: Chewtle
flavorText: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
flavorText: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Arrokuda
flavorText: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Barraskewda
flavorText: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Snom
flavorText: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

name: Frosmoth
flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Minun
flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Rotom
flavorText: With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Charjabug
flavorText: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

name: Vikavolt
flavorText: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Zeraora
flavorText: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Toxel
flavorText: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxel
flavorText: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

name: Morpeko
flavorText: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

name: Jynx
flavorText: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
flavorText: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Galarian Corsola
flavorText: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.

name: Galarian Cursola
flavorText: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

name: Mawile
flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Deoxys
subtype: Basic, Fusion Strike, Single Strike, Rapid Strike
flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Munna
flavorText: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

name: Musharna
flavorText: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Sandygast
flavorText: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

name: Palossand
flavorText: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

name: Indeedee
flavorText: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

name: Dreepy
flavorText: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

name: Drakloak
flavorText: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

name: Dragapult
flavorText: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.

name: Sandslash
flavorText: Thanks to its thick claws, it's good at climbing trees. There are plenty of Sandslash that park themselves in trees and go right to sleep.

name: Mankey
flavorText: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

name: Primeape
flavorText: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

name: Geodude
flavorText: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

name: Graveler
flavorText: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

name: Golem
flavorText: It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.

name: Onix
flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Steelix
flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Claydol
flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Landorus
flavorText: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Pancham
flavorText: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Stufful
flavorText: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
flavorText: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Clobbopus
flavorText: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

name: Grapploct
flavorText: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Falinks
flavorText: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Falinks
flavorText: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavorText: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavorText: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

name: Absol
flavorText: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: It booms out a victory croak when its prey goes down in defeat. This Pokémon and Seismitoad are related species.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Zorua
flavorText: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

name: Pangoro
flavorText: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Impidimp
flavorText: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Morgrem
flavorText: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavorText: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

name: Morpeko
flavorText: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavorText: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavorText: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

name: Excadrill
flavorText: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Durant
flavorText: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Klefki
flavorText: Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki began appearing in human settlements.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Meltan
flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Melmetal
flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Corviknight
flavorText: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.

name: Cufant
flavorText: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

name: Copperajah
flavorText: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Latias
flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

name: Latios
flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Goomy
flavorText: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as Goomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go into hiding. This is how they've survived.

name: Sliggoo
flavorText: The lump on its back contains its tiny brain. It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.

name: Goodra
flavorText: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.

name: Turtonator
flavorText: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.

name: Persian
flavorText: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

name: Chansey
flavorText: Because the eggs on their bellies have been overharvested by people in the past, the Chansey population remains very small.

name: Blissey
flavorText: This Pokémon is overflowing with love. Only Chansey that share a strong bond with their Trainer can evolve, so people say.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

name: Eevee
flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

name: Stantler
flavorText: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Buneary
flavorText: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it's attacked by an enemy.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: It's notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Diggersby
flavorText: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Rookidee
flavorText: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

name: Corvisquire
flavorText: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.

name: Wooloo
flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Wooloo
flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Dubwool
flavorText: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

name: Breloom
flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Tropius
flavorText: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Grotle
flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

name: Torterra
flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

name: Burmy
flavorText: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

name: Wormadam
flavorText: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Mothim
flavorText: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

name: Karrablast
flavorText: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Moltres
flavorText: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Monferno
flavorText: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

name: Infernape
flavorText: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Staryu
flavorText: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Lapras
flavorText: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Corphish
flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Crawdaunt
flavorText: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Piplup
flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

name: Beartic
flavorText: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

name: Eiscue
flavorText: The hair on its head connects to the surface of its brain. When this Pokémon has something on its mind, its hair chills the air around it.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

name: Electivire
