flavorText: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

name: Shinx
flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

name: Luxio
flavorText: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Starmie
flavorText: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Duskull
flavorText: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

name: Dusclops
flavorText: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

name: Chimecho
flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

name: Milcery
flavorText: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Alcremie
flavorText: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Nosepass
flavorText: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Flygon
flavorText: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

name: Wormadam
flavorText: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

name: Throh
flavorText: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh's belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer's sweat.

name: Sawk
flavorText: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it's best to quietly pass by.

name: Golett
flavorText: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

name: Golurk
flavorText: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

name: Grimer
flavorText: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

name: Muk
flavorText: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Impidimp
flavorText: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Morgrem
flavorText: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavorText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Wormadam
flavorText: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Probopass
flavorText: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

name: Heatran
flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Escavalier
flavorText: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

name: Klink
flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Gible
flavorText: Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.

name: Gabite
flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.

name: Axew
flavorText: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other's strength.

name: Fraxure

name: Vaporeon

name: Octillery

flavorText: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

name: Chesnaught
flavorText: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Scatterbug
flavorText: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

name: Spewpa
flavorText: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

name: Vivillon
flavorText: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

name: Skiddo
flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: Gogoat
flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

name: Slugma
flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Pansear
flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

name: Simisear
flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Braixen
flavorText: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Delphox
flavorText: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

name: Shellder
flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster
flavorText: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Staryu
flavorText: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

name: Starmie
flavorText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

name: Lapras
flavorText: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

name: Corsola
flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

name: Panpour
flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

name: Simipour
flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja
flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Raichu
flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

name: Ekans
flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

name: Arbok
flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

name: Spoink
flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

name: Grumpig
flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

name: Venipede
flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

name: Whirlipede
flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

name: Scolipede
flavorText: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

name: Phantump
flavorText: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

name: Trevenant
flavorText: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavorText: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Gourgeist
flavorText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: Diglett
flavorText: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Rhydon
flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Rhyperior
flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

name: Solrock
flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Timburr
flavorText: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

name: Gurdurr
flavorText: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

name: Conkeldurr
flavorText: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Sandile
flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

name: Zorua
flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Inkay
flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Inkay
flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Malamar
flavorText: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: Malamar
flavorText: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of all living creatures.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

name: Honedge
flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Doublade
flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won't want to be separated.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won't want to be separated.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.

name: Spritzee
flavorText: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

name: Aromatisse
flavorText: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

name: Swirlix
flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and as sticky as cotton candy.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Xerneas
flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Doduo
flavorText: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Dodrio
flavorText: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.

name: Tauros
flavorText: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backwards by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

name: Taillow
flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Swellow
flavorText: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty
flavorText: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Bibarel
flavorText: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

name: Herdier
flavorText: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Diggersby
flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Furfrou
flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: It stores Berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Burmy
flavorText: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

name: Wormadam
flavorText: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Mothim
flavorText: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

name: Snivy
flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Servine
flavorText: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

name: Serperior
flavorText: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Deerling
flavorText: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Moltres
flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degree Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Seel
flavorText: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of -40 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.

name: Omanyte
flavorText: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

name: Omastar
flavorText: Once wrapped around its prey, it never lets go. It eats the prey by tearing at it with sharp fangs.

name: White Kyurem
flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Binacle
flavorText: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

name: Barbaracle
flavorText: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

name: Weezing
flavorText: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

name: Mew
flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Spoink
flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

name: Grumpig
flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

name: Gothita
flavorText: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something only Gothita can see.

name: Solosis
flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Duosion
flavorText: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

name: Reuniclus
flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

name: Diglett
flavorText: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Marowak
flavorText: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

name: Kabuto
flavorText: This Pokémon was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

name: Kabutops
flavorText: A slim and fast swimmer. It slices its prey with its sharp sickles and drinks the body fluids.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Wormadam
flavorText: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Riolu
flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Riolu
flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Lucario
flavorText: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

name: Carbink
flavorText: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It's occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

name: Carbink
flavorText: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It's occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

name: Zygarde
flavorText: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

name: Tyranitar
flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

name: Wormadam
flavorText: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

name: Lucario
flavorText: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

name: Whimsicott
flavorText: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

name: Meowth
flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

name: Aerodactyl
flavorText: This vicious Pokémon is said to have flown in ancient skies while shrieking high-pitched cries.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

name: Lugia
flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Whismur
flavorText: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

name: Loudred
flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Exploud
flavorText: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor–or like an earthquake has struck.

name: Minccino
flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Minccino
flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

name: Tangela
flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

name: Hoppip
flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Skiploom
flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

name: Jumpluff
flavorText: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

name: Yanma
flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Seedot
flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

name: Foongus
flavorText: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.

name: Amoonguss
flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: Its legs grow strong while it chases after its parent. It runs in fields and mountains all day.

name: Rapidash
flavorText: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Monferno
flavorText: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

name: Infernape
flavorText: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Litleo
flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

name: Volcanion
flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Mantine
flavorText: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

name: Shellos
flavorText: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.

name: Gastrodon
flavorText: It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott
flavorText: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

name: Samurott
flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Clauncher
flavorText: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

name: Clawitzer
flavorText: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

name: Bergmite
flavorText: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

name: Avalugg
flavorText: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

name: Mareep
flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Joltik
flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavorText: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

name: Nidorino
flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Nidoking
flavorText: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: These Pokémon are called the "Signpost for Wandering Spirits." Children holding them sometimes vanish.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: It's drowsy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Lampent
flavorText: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

name: Hoopa
flavorText: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

name: Mankey
flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

name: Primeape
flavorText: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

name: Nosepass
flavorText: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

name: Probopass
flavorText: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Anorith
flavorText: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

name: Armaldo
flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Shieldon
flavorText: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

name: Bastiodon
flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

name: Klink
flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Klang
flavorText: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn't return, it will die.

name: Klinklang
flavorText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

name: Marill
flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

name: Azumarill
flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

name: Klefki
flavorText: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

name: Xerneas
flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: Deino
flavorText: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

name: Meowth
flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Persian
flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

name: Aipom
flavorText: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

name: Braviary
flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

name: Metapod
flavorText: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: This Pokémon is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Blue plant vines cloak the Pokémon's identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.

name: Charmander
flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavorText: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: A Pokémon that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

name: Poliwhirl
flavorText: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

name: Poliwrath
flavorText: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

name: Seel
flavorText: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of -40 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.

name: Staryu
flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: Starmie
flavorText: This Pokémon has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

name: Magneton
flavorText: A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to Screech or suddenly Self-Destruct.

name: Electrode
flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavorText: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

name: Nidorino
flavorText: It is easily angered. By swinging its well-developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.

name: Nidoking
flavorText: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

name: Gastly
flavorText: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.

name: Haunter
flavorText: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: A descendant of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.

name: Koffing
flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: A Pokémon whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.

name: Mew
flavorText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

name: Diglett
flavorText: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Machop
flavorText: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavorText: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: Machamp
flavorText: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Onix
flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

name: Raticate
flavorText: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

name: Farfetch'd
flavorText: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.

name: Doduo
flavorText: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Chansey
flavorText: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

name: Porygon
flavorText: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial Pokémon.

name: ナッシー[Exeggutor]
flavorText: Dr.オーヤマ考案「日米交流カード」パーティ気分で和洋せっちゅう。

name: Flying Pikachu
flavorText: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

name: Surfing Pikachu
flavorText: One summer, a group of Pikachu was found riding the waves at the local beach.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Metapod
flavorText: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

name: Seedot
flavorText: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: Roselia
flavorText: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.

name: Roserade
flavorText: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.

name: Maractus
flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

name: Rapidash
flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

name: Litleo
flavorText: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: Litleo
flavorText: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Qwilfish
flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

name: Feebas
flavorText: It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted streams and lakes. No one pays any attention to it.

name: Milotic
flavorText: Milotic is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

name: Spheal
flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy they clap fins.

name: Sealeo
flavorText: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

name: Walrein
flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

name: Luvdisc
flavorText: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

name: Bergmite
flavorText: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

name: Avalugg
flavorText: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Shinx
flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

name: Luxray
flavorText: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey–even those taking shelter behind a wall.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Duskull
flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Dusclops
flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Espurr
flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Skrelp
flavorText: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

name: Geodude
flavorText: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Graveler
flavorText: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

name: Golem
flavorText: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

name: Binacle
flavorText: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

name: Barbaracle
flavorText: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

name: Weavile
flavorText: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

name: Stunky
flavorText: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

name: Stunky
flavorText: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

name: Skuntank
flavorText: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

name: Sandile
flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

name: Forretress
flavorText: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

name: Durant
flavorText: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

name: Flabébé
flavorText: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

name: Flabébé
flavorText: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

name: Floette
flavorText: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

name: Floette
flavorText: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

name: Florges
flavorText: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

name: Spritzee
flavorText: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

name: Carbink
flavorText: Born from temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Dragalge
flavorText: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

name: Goomy
flavorText: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

name: Sliggoo
flavorText: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

name: Goodra
flavorText: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Pidgey
flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
flavorText: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Sentret
flavorText: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.

name: Furret
flavorText: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

name: Miltank
flavorText: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

name: Buneary
flavorText: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Furfrou
flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Bellsprout
flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
flavorText: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel
flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Shelmet
flavorText: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

name: Accelgor
flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

name: Magmar
flavorText: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

name: Torchic
flavorText: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

name: Combusken
flavorText: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

name: Blaziken
flavorText: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

name: Poliwhirl
flavorText: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.

name: Poliwrath
flavorText: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

name: Politoed
flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

name: Glaceon
flavorText: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

name: Beartic
flavorText: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

name: Clauncher
flavorText: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

name: Clawitzer
flavorText: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

name: Amaura
flavorText: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

name: Aurorus
flavorText: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Raichu
flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Electabuzz
flavorText: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its body glows a whitish blue.

name: Electivire
flavorText: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

name: Plusle
flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Minun
flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Thundurus
flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

name: Hypno
flavorText: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.

name: Jynx
flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

name: Skorupi
flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Golett
flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: Golurk
flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Machop
flavorText: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

name: Machoke
flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavorText: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

name: Breloom
flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

name: Mienshao
flavorText: It wields the fur on its arm like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Landorus
flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Pancham
flavorText: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: Pancham
flavorText: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: Tyrunt
flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

name: Tyrantrum
flavorText: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

name: Drapion
flavorText: It takes great pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

name: Pangoro
flavorText: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavorText: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

name: Sylveon
flavorText: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

name: Klefki
flavorText: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Flygon
flavorText: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

name: Noivern
flavorText: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

name: Eevee
flavorText: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Vigoroth
flavorText: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

name: Slaking
flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Tornadus
flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Noibat
flavorText: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: Venonat
flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

name: Venomoth
flavorText: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

name: Yanma
flavorText: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Karrablast
flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

name: Litleo
flavorText: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Krabby
flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
flavorText: The large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Totodile
flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr
flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Finneon
flavorText: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

name: Lumineon
flavorText: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

name: Frillish
flavorText: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

name: Jellicent
flavorText: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

name: Alomomola
flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Joltik
flavorText: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Zubat
flavorText: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from it mouth.

name: Golbat
flavorText: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

name: Crobat
flavorText: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

name: Wobbuffet
flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

name: Gulpin
flavorText: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach compromises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

name: Swalot
flavorText: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

name: Munna
flavorText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Musharna
flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Litwick
flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavorText: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Gourgeist
flavorText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Roggenrola
flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

name: Boldore
flavorText: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

name: Gigalith
flavorText: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. Murkrow and Meowth loot one another's stashes.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

name: Poochyena
flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Heatran
flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Escavalier
flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Klefki
flavorText: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: Swirlix
flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and as sticky as cotton candy.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Diancie
flavorText: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Deino
flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: Their heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Goomy
flavorText: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

name: Sliggoo
flavorText: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

name: Goodra
flavorText: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Spearow
flavorText: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.

name: Fearow
flavorText: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land or rest.

name: Chansey
flavorText: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its egg with injured people.

name: Blissey
flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

name: Girafarig
flavorText: While it sleeps, the head of its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn't need to sleep.

name: Whismur
flavorText: It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

name: Loudred
flavorText: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then using its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.

name: Exploud
flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

name: Regigigas
flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Diggersby
flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Furfrou
flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Head Ringer Team Flare Hyper Gear
Jamming Net Team Flare Hyper Gear
Weedle
flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Tangela
flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

name: Tangrowth
